sponsored.t: Requires the board of elections to notify victims of domestic violence whose registration is maintained as confidential of the expiration of the confidentiality of such registration records
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections to notify victims of domestic violence whose registration is maintained as confidential of the expiration of the confidentiality of such registration records; requires such notice to include information on a new application for confidentiality of records.

sponsored.t: Requires veterinary clinics to file notice and documentation to the attorney general before completing certain transactions
sponsored.sum: Requires veterinary clinics to file notice and documentation to the attorney general to determine if certain transactions would be against the public interest for veterinary care access prior to completing such transactions; prohibits certain negative use restrictions imposed against veterinary clinics by private agreements.

sponsored.t: Relates to releasing victims of domestic violence from certain contracts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes one or more individuals who are under a shared contract to opt-out of such contract without a fee, penalty or charge due to status as a domestic violence victim; prohibits the company from transferring any contractual or billing responsibility of such shared contract to any other account holders on such shared contract; prevents companies from prohibiting a person who has opted-out due to domestic violence status to enter into a new contract.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to provide disposable diapers and wipes and infant formula for newborns and menstrual products at the time of discharge
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals which provide maternity services to provide disposable diapers and wipes and offer a one-week supply of infant formula for newborns, and to provide a supply of menstrual products, at the time of discharge; clarifies that offering and providing such infant formula shall not affect a hospital's eligibility to participate in the department of health's breastfeeding friendly practice designation program.

sponsored.t: Requires property/casualty insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services
sponsored.sum: Requires property/casualty insurance carriers to provide access to underwriting models or granular claim data to the department of financial services to evaluate underwriting practices and risk assessment methodologies.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the consideration of credit history in the underwriting, cancellation, renewal or calculation of cost of homeowners' insurance
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting insurers from refusing to underwrite, cancel or refuse to renew a policy for homeowners' insurance based on the credit history of an applicant or an insured.

sponsored.t: Relates to audiovisual advertisements and synthetic performer disclosures and materially deceptive media disclosures in certain political communications
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure for the entire duration that a synthetic performer is featured in an audiovisual advertisement; requires materially deceptive media disclosures in video political communications to be visible for the entire duration that materially deceptive media is shown.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring insurance coverage for salpingectomy for ovarian cancer prevention
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage for salpingectomy for ovarian cancer prevention.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax rebate program for rent-stabilized housing
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax rebate program for rent-stabilized housing that targets buildings with individually occupied rent-stabilized apartments where the property tax burden significantly exceeds rental income.

sponsored.t: Creates a task force to examine, evaluate and regulate med spas and provides for certain provisions related to med spas
sponsored.sum: Creates a task force to examine, evaluate and regulate med spas; provides for certain provisions related to med spas including inspections and the maintenance of liability insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing notice of polling place location changes
sponsored.sum: Requires the board of elections to publish notice of a polling place location change thirty days before the change or on the earliest known date of such change in the event of an emergency; provides for the use of electronic mail to notify voters of polling place location changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to epinephrine devices in schools
sponsored.sum: Requires epinephrine devices in schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulating private equity in child care
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulating private equity in child care; requires certain child care providers to report certain information to the office of children and family services; establishes additional reporting requirements for child care providers that participate in the New York state child care assistance program or receive certain public funding, and for child care providers that include a significant equity investor; establishes certain conditions on the use of public funds received by child care providers; establishes statewide reporting requirements related thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the importation and sale of certain household cleaning products that use animal testing
sponsored.sum: Prohibits manufacturers from importing and selling certain household cleaning products that use animal testing, if the animal testing was conducted on or after January first, two thousand twenty-eight.

sponsored.t: Relates to divorce and the consideration by the court of companion animals
sponsored.sum: Directs the court to consider whether the companion animal was acquired prior to or during the marriage; the basic daily needs of the companion animal; the party who generally facilitates veterinary care for the companion animal; the party who generally provides the companion animal with social interaction; the party who generally ensures compliance with state and local regulations regarding the companion animal; and the party who provides the greater ability to financially support the companion animal.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the giveaway or exchange of live fish as prizes in games, drawing, contests, sweepstakes or promotions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the giveaway or exchange of live fish as prizes in games, drawings, contests, sweepstakes or promotions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to Abraham Joshua Heschel School
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dormitory authority to provide financing to Abraham Joshua Heschel School.

sponsored.t: Requires the disclosure of digitally altered images in an advertisement or other promotional material for the sale or lease of real property
sponsored.sum: Requires the disclosure of digitally altered images in an advertisement or other promotional material for the sale or lease of real property; requires the website posting to include the unaltered version of the image.

sponsored.t: Relates to campaign contribution and expenditure limitations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits campaign contributions by business entities other than a political committee; limits contributions by persons other than political parties and candidates in excess of $25,000 annually; limits contributions to political committees in excess of $2,500 annually; authorizes adjustments every two years based on the consumer price index.

sponsored.t: Enacts the Legionnaires' disease prevention act
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of environmental conservation and the department of health, owners or operators of public water systems, and owners or operators of buildings to take actions to prevent and control waterborne pathogens including legionella from source-to-tap.

sponsored.t: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of addiction services and supports to collect certain demographic data for incarcerated individuals in medication assisted treatment programs.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of restraints on incarcerated individuals during labor, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant persons during a custodial interrogation
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of restraints on and the use of force against incarcerated individuals during labor and incarcerated individuals who have experienced different pregnancy outcomes, absent extraordinary circumstances, and on pregnant and post-pregnancy persons during a custodial interrogation; provides for certain exceptions for restraints to be used and in such case limits the use to wrist restraints.

sponsored.t: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines
sponsored.sum: Provides liability protections for health care providers who issue vaccines so long as such vaccination does not arise out of willful misconduct or gross negligence.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of breast pumps to certain incarcerated birth parents and allowing children to remain with their incarcerated birth parent for a period of time
sponsored.sum: Relates to the provision of breast pumps and related collection and storage materials to certain incarcerated nursing birth parents who are confined in or committed to an institution or local correctional facility with or without their child subject to specific time limitations; requires institutions and local correctional facilities to provide pumps and related materials to such incarcerated birth parents; requires the commissioner of corrections and community supervision to issue an annual report on data relating to incarcerated birth parents.

sponsored.t: Establishes a co-shelter toolkit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a co-shelter toolkit of best practices, resources, case studies and other information deemed helpful to inform and encourage the implementation and sustenance of co-shelter models for victims of domestic violence and people experiencing homelessness with companion animals; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires epinephrine devices for anaphylaxis and staff trained to use them at child day care centers
sponsored.sum: Requires child day care centers to have epinephrine devices and staff trained to use them on site in case of anaphylaxis or other severe allergic reaction.

sponsored.t: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the bathrooms of private colleges and universities
sponsored.sum: Requires that free menstrual products be provided in the commonly used bathrooms of private universities.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a menopause informational and resource webpage on the department website
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to establish and maintain a menopause informational and resource webpage on the department website.

sponsored.t: Requires retailers to post warning signs of the tracking and collecting of customers biometric data through electronic devices
sponsored.sum: Requires retailers to post warning signs of the tracking and collecting of customers biometric data through electronic devices; provides for civil penalties.

sponsored.t: Relates to including the illegal conversions of dwelling units in the definition of harassment
sponsored.sum: Relates to including the illegal conversions of dwelling units in the definition of harassment.

sponsored.t: Permits multiple transfers of low-income housing tax credits
sponsored.sum: Permits multiple transfers of low-income housing tax credits.

sponsored.t: Relates to energy efficiency improvements and certain alterations to multiple dwellings
sponsored.sum: Provides for energy efficiency improvements to certain windows; relates to certain alterations concerning windows and HVAC equipment in multiple dwellings.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices; requires such informational pamphlet to be available on the department of health's website; requires practitioners to distribute such informational pamphlet to patients seeking contraceptives.

sponsored.t: Prohibits landlords from including incorrect information re rent decontrol in certain leases and renewals pertaining to units in the Affordable New York Housing Program
sponsored.sum: Prohibits landlords from including incorrect information relating to rent decontrol in certain leases and renewals thereof; imposes a violation punishable by a fine of $1000 for a violation by a landlord; requires the standardization of certain notices pertaining to units subject to the Affordable New York Housing Program.

sponsored.t: Establishes protections for minors who are featured in compensated video content
sponsored.sum: Establishes protections for minors who are featured in compensated video content that generate earnings from being shared on social media or other video-sharing websites.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Maternal Health, Dignity and Consent act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits drug, cannabis or alcohol testing of pregnant or postpartum individuals and newborns unless the individual consents and it is within the scope of medical care, or the testing is necessary for a medical emergency.

sponsored.t: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against them in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance
sponsored.sum: Prohibits requiring that an individual have a court proceeding initiated against them in order to qualify for a rent arrears grant or ongoing rental assistance.

sponsored.t: Repeals provisions of the administrative code of the city of New York relating to the establishment of maximum base rents using the maximum gross building rental formula; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions relating to the establishment of maximum base rents using the maximum gross building rental formula.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting technical changes to the good cause eviction law
sponsored.sum: Relates to enacting technical changes to the good cause eviction law.

sponsored.t: Provides for the protection of health information
sponsored.sum: Provides for the protection of health information; establishes requirements for communications to individuals about their health information; requires either written consent or a designated necessary purpose for the processing of an individual's health information.

sponsored.t: Prohibits dynamic pricing, algorithm or automated pricing tools in the sale or rental of any residential dwelling unit
sponsored.sum: Prohibits dynamic pricing, algorithm or automated pricing tools in the sale or rental of any residential dwelling unit; prohibits the use of online real estate auction platforms for rental units where the owner has a direct or indirect ownership interest in such platform.

sponsored.t: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits utility service terminations in multiple dwellings; authorizes utility companies or municipalities to commence an action against the owner of the premises affected to seek the appointment of a receiver of rents or payments for use and occupancy or common charges.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crime of benefiting from a labor trafficking venture, benefiting from a sex trafficking venture; creates a civil action relating thereto; and revives certain civil actions relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of benefiting from a labor trafficking venture, benefiting from a sex trafficking venture and aggravated benefiting from a sex trafficking venture; establishes civil action for victims of benefiting from a trafficking venture; revives such actions otherwise barred by the existing statute of limitations, grants trial preference to such actions; directs the chief administrator of the courts to promulgate rules for the timely adjudication of certain revived actions.

sponsored.t: Relates to outdoor restraints of dogs
sponsored.sum: Relates to outdoor restraints of dogs; prohibits inhumane tethering, including during dangerous weather conditions when a weather alert, advisory or warning is in effect; provides for civil penalties for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires certain owners of multiple dwellings in N.Y. city to designate a secure space for packages to be delivered to
sponsored.sum: Requires owners of multiple dwellings with fifty or more units in cities with a population of one million or more to designate a secure, locked, monitored space, accessible only to staff, residents, or delivery people, for packages to be delivered to.

sponsored.t: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish the results of annual audits of approved applications for temporary major capital improvement increases on its website annually
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to publish the results of annual audits of approved applications for temporary major capital improvement increases on its website annually.

sponsored.t: Provides for licensure of school psychology practitioners
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensure of school psychology practitioners; authorizes the use of the title "licensed school psychology practitioner" to licensed or exempt individuals; defines practice of licensed school psychology practitioners; sets forth requirements for professional licensure (including educational attainment, experience, exam and fee); provides for issuance of limited permits under specified circumstances; identifies exempt persons; establishes mandatory continuing education requirements.

sponsored.t: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program
sponsored.sum: Establishes an affordable independent senior housing assistance program which shall provide grants within amounts appropriated or otherwise available therefor to affordable independent senior housing properties to establish and operate resident assistance programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements when landlords offer tenants the option of rent reporting
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements when landlords offer tenants the option of rent reporting to a consumer reporting agency to boost such tenant's credit score.

sponsored.t: Relates to pet breeders; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to pet breeders; changes the term "pet dealer" to "pet breeder"; amends the definition of pet breeders; repeals certain provisions of law related thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to liability of cities and counties for negligence in the placement of a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to the duty owed by cities and counties to children in the legal custody of such cities and counties with respect to the placement of children; provides a statutory private right of action for compensatory damage.

sponsored.t: Requires the office for the prevention of domestic violence provide informational materials on removing an abuser's access to a smart home
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for the prevention of domestic violence provide informational materials on removing an abuser's access to a smart home and the use of other technology for harassment.

sponsored.t: Relates to the commencement of certain sexual offense actions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the commencement of certain sexual offense actions; extends the time for such commencement to two years and six months after the effective date of the section of law allowing such actions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the  'R.I.D.E.R  Rider Interests Deserve Empowering Representation' Act; relates to the powers and duties of the citizens advisory committee of the MTA
sponsored.sum: Relates to the powers and duties of the citizens advisory committee of the MTA and membership on the Long Island Rail Road commuter council, the Metro-North railroad commuter council, and the New York city transit riders council; provides such committee with access to certain information.

sponsored.t: Requires non-preferential opportunity for use of amenities in certain buildings and apartments
sponsored.sum: Requires non-preferential opportunity for use of amenities in certain buildings and apartments; requires that rental tenants must be provided with the opportunity to use amenities commonly accessible to other tenants of the multiple dwelling and not unique to an individual unit.

sponsored.t: Relates to information to be provided with all new and renewal leases for certain housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords of certain housing accommodations to include with all new and renewal leases, on any rent bills, including any electronic communication the informational material describing eligibility for and the benefits of the senior rent increase exemption program and the disability rent increase exemption program.

sponsored.t: Requires landlords to replace a lock on a tenant's door when requested by a victim of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to replace a lock on a tenant's dwelling door within 24 hours of a request by a tenant who is a victim of domestic violence; provides civil penalties for violations in relation thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to conversions of real property in public housing developments in relation to the RAD program
sponsored.sum: Relates to conversions of real property in public housing developments in relation to the RAD program; sets notice requirements for public housing authorities.

sponsored.t: Establishes certain rights upon the expiration of ground lease residential cooperative apartment buildings
sponsored.sum: Establishes certain rights upon the expiration of ground lease residential cooperative apartment buildings.

sponsored.t: Requires certain landlords and property managers to provide notice to tenants on proper protocols for recycling
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords and property managers of public and private multifamily buildings in cities with a population of a million or more to provide notice to tenants on proper protocol for recycling including information on materials that are acceptable; requires the division of sanitation to develop an example notice and make it available on its website for use by landlords and property managers.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain alterations to multiple dwellings; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to certain alterations based upon which room is being altered in a multiple dwelling.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the crime of voyeurism
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of voyeurism in the first and second degree which is defined as when someone for their own amusement, entertainment, profit, sexual arousal or sexual gratification trespasses or uses an instrument to observe for the purpose of viewing a person dressing or undressing or the sexual or other intimate parts of such person at a place and time when such person has a reasonable expectation of privacy, without such person's knowledge or consent.

sponsored.t: Provides access to menstrual products in toilet facilities in certain public buildings
sponsored.sum: Provides access to menstrual products in toilet facilities in public buildings owned or leased by the state that are determined to be opened to the public; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Prohibits landlords from requiring a fee for nonessential services in a tenant's base rent
sponsored.sum: Prohibits landlords from requiring a fee for nonessential services in a tenant's base rent, including cable, internet and garage usage, as a condition of leasing a dwelling; excludes buildings with less than three dwelling units.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of the pesticide paraquat
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the distribution, sale, offer for sale, and use of any pesticide product containing paraquat dichloride or any other chemical form of paraquat.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a Legionnaires' disease awareness and education program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a Legionnaires' disease awareness and education program on the symptoms, diagnosis and treatment of Legionnaires' disease.

sponsored.t: Requires a procedure for notification when a family member applies and is denied by a limited-profit housing company to succeed a lease or occupancy agreement
sponsored.sum: Requires a procedure for notification of a family member of a tenant or cooperator in the case that their application to succeed a lease or occupancy agreement is denied by a limited-profit housing company.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of coal tar and its use in pavement products
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of coal tar and its use in pavement products.

sponsored.t: Requires practitioners to discuss certain risks with a patient who is being prescribed a controlled substance or an opioid analgesic
sponsored.sum: Requires practitioners to discuss certain risks with a patient who is being prescribed a schedule II controlled substance or an opioid analgesic; requires the department of health to develop practitioner guidelines.

sponsored.t: Removes certain language relating to requests for reconsideration of creditor determinations
sponsored.sum: Removes certain conditional language relating to the submission of requests for reconsideration of creditor determinations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the docketing of judgments imposing civil penalties for the violation of certain requirements imposed by the zoning resolution of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to the docketing of judgments imposing civil penalties for the violation of certain requirements imposed by the zoning resolution of the city of New York; makes other technical changes.

sponsored.t: Requires epinephrine auto-injector devices at children's overnight, summer day and traveling summer camps
sponsored.sum: Requires epinephrine devices at children's overnight, summer day and traveling summer day camps.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the presence of epinephrine auto-injector devices on pre-school premises
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the presence of epinephrine auto-injector devices on pre-school premises.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of automated lending decision-making tools by banks for the purposes of making lending decisions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of automated lending decision-making tools by banks for the purposes of making lending decisions; allows loan applicants to consent to or opt out of such use.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for certain contracts for materials, supplies, or services
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for certain contracts for materials, supplies, or services under $50,000; assures the prudent and economical use of public moneys in the best interests of the taxpayers; requires an authority in the city of New York to develop a procurement corruption prevention training program; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds
sponsored.sum: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based solely on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds.

sponsored.t: Prohibits Medicaid from requiring prior authorization for certain HIV medications
sponsored.sum: Prohibits Medicaid service providers from requiring prior authorization for antiretroviral prescription drugs for the treatment or prevention of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

sponsored.t: Requires Medicaid to cover gender-affirming care regardless of federal funding; prohibits discriminatory practices by health care entities and insurers; relates to coverage for treatment for gender dysphoria
sponsored.sum: Requires Medicaid to cover gender-affirming care regardless of federal funding; prohibits discriminatory practices by health care entities including hospitals, certain professionals, and insurers; requires insurance coverage for services or treatments for gender dysphoria or gender incongruence.

sponsored.t: Relates to microchipping of certain animals possessed by animal protective associations and rescue organizations
sponsored.sum: Permits microchipping of certain animals possessed by animal protective associations and rescue organizations.

sponsored.t: Requires reporting of a criminal conviction and sentence of a physician
sponsored.sum: Requires the reporting of sentences of certain medical professionals to the office of professional medical conduct within twenty-four hours; requires the department of health to disseminate a criminal conviction and sentence of a physician within forty-eight hours of receipt.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the trade of farmed fur products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the trade of farmed fur products if any of the fur was sourced from an animal that was raised, maintained, kept, or housed for all or part of its life on a fur farm.

sponsored.t: Relates to interest on money deposited or advanced for the rental of property from an aggregate portfolio of six or more rental units
sponsored.sum: Relates to interest on money deposited or advanced for the rental of property from an aggregate portfolio of six or more rental units.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of trawling, gill nets, and trammel nets except for scientific purposes; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of trawling, gill nets, and trammel nets except for scientific purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to priority applicants and inspection of units under the housing access voucher pilot program
sponsored.sum: Relates to priority applicants and inspection of units under the housing access voucher pilot program; provides that priority shall be given both to applicants who are homeless and who are at risk of losing their federal rental subsidy; provides that housing access voucher local administrators shall inspect units for which a housing assistance payment contract is established.

sponsored.t: Relates to the contents of claims
sponsored.sum: Provides exceptions from the requirement of specificity in pleadings in certain cases involving sexual offenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to cooperative or limited-profit housing companies and conversions to cooperative or condominium ownership in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Includes certain cooperative or limited-profit housing companies for purposes of conversions to cooperative or condominium ownership in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's height or weight in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination on the basis of a person's height or weight in opportunities of employment, housing, and access to public accommodations.

sponsored.t: Expands documentation requirements for limited-profit housing companies
sponsored.sum: Expands documentation requirements for limited-profit housing companies when providing information to the commissioner of housing of the state of New York and any relevant supervising agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to sex offenses involving mental health care providers
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of mental health care provider for the purposes of the penal law; expands the conditions under which a person is deemed incapable of consent.

sponsored.t: Requires a landlord to have clean hands to bring action for rent or eviction in certain cases
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to conditions precedent to the bringing of certain actions or proceedings.

sponsored.t: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception
sponsored.sum: Requires entities that submit records to state agencies that are excepted from disclosure under FOIL to periodically re-apply for the exception.

sponsored.t: Relates to disclosure of the use of artificial intelligence by law enforcement agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires policing agencies to conduct an inventory of, and develop a publicly-available policy for, any artificial intelligence used to aid criminal investigations.

sponsored.t: Establishes a food bank for pets pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a food bank for pets pilot program which provides food for cats and dogs to pet owners who have financial challenges in providing for their pets without assistance.

sponsored.t: Extends the answer time when a major capital improvement rent increase has been filed to ninety days
sponsored.sum: Extends the answer time when a major capital improvement rent increase has been filed to ninety days.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the recording of conveyances suspected of being fraudulent
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the recording of conveyances suspected of being fraudulent; requires the clerk or registrar to report transactions believed to be or suspected of being fraudulent to the office of the attorney general and to local law enforcement or sheriff's office.

sponsored.t: Relates to the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants
sponsored.sum: Prohibits landlords from restricting the installation of appliances or fixtures by tenants; provides that the landlord is not compelled to change utilities or alter the unit for such installation; prohibits surcharge where tenant pays utilities directly to provider; requires a tenant restore appliances or fixtures to the condition they were prior to being installed or allowing such appliances or fixtures remain in the rental unit at no cost to the landlord; defines "appliances or fixtures".

sponsored.t: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance to provide an informational notice to supportive housing tenants
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of mental health to provide an informational notice to supportive housing tenants which contains information about a supportive housing tenant's rights as a tenant, information about their building and other related information.

sponsored.t: Provides for motor fuel pollution and health impact labelling requirements
sponsored.sum: Provides for motor fuel pollution and health impact labelling requirements for retail outlets.

sponsored.t: Requires annual inspections of Mitchell-Lama buildings; requires notification and certifications
sponsored.sum: Requires annual inspections of Mitchell-Lama buildings; requires the appointment of housing management representatives to perform such inspections; requires notification of violations to housing companies; requires such housing companies to certify correction of violations.

sponsored.t: Requires the development of mental illness training for providers of temporary housing
sponsored.sum: Requires the office of temporary and disability assistance, in conjunction with the office of mental health and the office of children and family services, to develop a mental illness training course to be utilized by providers of temporary housing assistance to focus on recognizing signs and symptoms of mental illness.

sponsored.t: Includes positive rental payment information reporting in the New York state low income housing tax credit program; requires landlords to offer tenants the option of positive rental payment information reporting
sponsored.sum: Includes positive rental payment information reporting as a preference in the evaluation of project applications in the New York state low income housing tax credit program; requires landlords to offer tenants the option of positive rental payment information reporting; creates notice requirements for the election of positive rental payment information reporting.

sponsored.t: Expands the type of conduct that qualifies as harassment of tenants
sponsored.sum: Expands the type of conduct that qualifies as harassment of tenants; provides that such conduct will result in tenants being entitled to treble damages.

sponsored.t: Provides for the restriction of substances in menstrual products
sponsored.sum: Restricts certain substances from being used in menstrual products; relates to the effectiveness of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires that nuisance wildlife control operators disclose to the client that euthanasia may be used to resolve a wildlife related problem
sponsored.sum: Requires that nuisance wildlife control operators disclose to the client, in writing, that euthanasia may be used to resolve a wildlife related problem.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York election officer protection act
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the intimidation, obstruction, or the unlawful dissemination of personal information of election officers; makes election officers eligible for the address confidentiality program.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning perimenopause and menopause
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to develop an informational pamphlet concerning perimenopause and menopause, which shall include information concerning the stages of perimenopause and menopause, the signs and side effects, and options for the management and treatment; requires that such informational pamphlet be made available on the department's website and available for order as a printed deliverable; requires practitioners to make such informational pamphlet available to patients.

sponsored.t: Clarifies provisions related to eviction where a landlord seeks to demolish a housing accommodation
sponsored.sum: Requires the entire demolition of a housing accommodation or building by a landlord to qualify as a good cause eviction.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring homeless shelters to keep an opioid antagonist on hand, have at least one trained employee on duty at all times, and develop a training plan for opioid overdoses
sponsored.sum: Requires homeless shelters to keep an opioid antagonist on hand at all times and trained personnel when required by applicable law, regulation, code, or operating plan approved by a social services district or the commissioner otherwise requires employees to be at the premises; sets out the requirements for the training of those employees; develops a training plan for opioid overdoses in conjunction with a registered opioid overdose prevention program.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing discrimination and increasing awareness of rights for employees with menstrual-related conditions, perimenopausal-related conditions and menopausal-related conditions
sponsored.sum: Relates to preventing discrimination and increasing awareness of rights for employees with menstrual-related conditions, perimenopausal-related conditions and menopausal-related conditions; requires employers to provide employees with an informational pamphlet on any regulations relating to the rights of employees.

sponsored.t: Provides insurance coverage for perimenopausal and menopausal care and treatment
sponsored.sum: Provides hospital, surgical and medical insurance coverage for perimenopausal and menopausal care and treatment.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax exemption for buildings with bird-friendly design
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax exemption for buildings constructed or improved according to bird-friendly design standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to rent registration statements to be filed for vacant units
sponsored.sum: Requires owners of housing accommodations subject to rent registration to file an additional statement at three month intervals, until the unit is occupied.

sponsored.t: Requires the transmission by mail or personal delivery of a certified copy of the statements of canvassing boards to the state board of elections
sponsored.sum: Requires a certified copy of the statements of canvassing boards to be transmitted by mail or personal delivery to the state board of elections.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of income for purposes of the senior citizen rent increase exemptions (SCRIE) program and the disability rent increase exemption (DRIE)
sponsored.sum: Excludes Medicare premiums from the definition of income for purposes of the senior citizen rent increase exemptions (SCRIE) program and the disability rent increase exemption (DRIE).

sponsored.t: Relates to dispensing certain controlled substances for use by a person with a substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Relates to dispensing certain controlled substances for use by a person with a substance use disorder during certain emergency medical treatment, or to relieve acute withdrawal symptoms.

sponsored.t: Relates to right of action for claims arising out of coerced debts
sponsored.sum: Relates to actions for claims arising out of coerced debts; limits certain actions; established a right of action against person who causes another to incur coerced debt.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer
sponsored.sum: Requires advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer; imposes a $1,000 civil penalty for a first violation and a $5,000 penalty for any subsequent violation.

sponsored.t: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats
sponsored.sum: Authorizes emergency medical care personnel to provide basic first aid to dogs and cats.

sponsored.t: Prohibits naming dependent children under the age of 18 in petitions to recover possession of real property and eviction warrants
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits naming dependent children under the age of 18 living in the same household with a parent or guardian in petitions to recover possession of real property and eviction warrants; seals any records pertaining to dependent children under the age of 18 living in the same household with a parent or guardian who were residing on or removed from such property.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discriminatory advertisement practices in relation to the sale or renting of housing
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discriminatory advertisement practices in relation to the sale or renting of housing; allows for the division of human rights to investigate such occurrences.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of entertainment vapor products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of entertainment vapor products, or any vapor product that has bluetooth, wireless internet, or other internet connectivity, or the ability to play virtual games, play music, or display photos or other animations on the device.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction in senior high schools regarding calling 911 when witnessing or experiencing a drug or alcohol overdose
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in senior high schools regarding calling 911 when witnessing or experiencing a drug or alcohol overdose; provides that pupils shall receive instruction regarding the lawfulness of calling 911 when witnessing or experiencing a drug or alcohol overdose; encourages pupils to call 911 when witnessing or experiencing a drug or alcohol overdose without fear of arrest.

sponsored.t: Requires electronic cigarette packaging to include a warning that the product may pose an explosion hazard
sponsored.sum: Requires electronic cigarette packaging to include a warning that the product may pose an explosion hazard.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the removal of managed natural landscapes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the removal of managed natural landscapes that are maintained within the bounds of private property.

sponsored.t: Provides for evidence that proves or tends to prove that a victim has been convicted of a prostitution offense shall not be admissible
sponsored.sum: Removes from admissibility evidence that proves or tends to prove that a victim has been convicted of a prostitution offense within three years prior to the sex offense which is the subject of the prosecution.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the standards of monthly need and home energy grant amounts for persons in receipt of public assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to increasing the standards of monthly need and home energy grant amounts for persons in receipt of public assistance.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing animals as sentient beings
sponsored.sum: Establishes that animals are sentient beings capable of experiencing pain, stress, and fear; establishes an animal can be a victim of a crime.

sponsored.t: Relates to the standards of monthly need for persons in receipt of public assistance
sponsored.sum: Relates to the standards of monthly need for persons in receipt of public assistance; provides for an increased monthly allowance for persons and families residing in shelters.

sponsored.t: Requires teachers and library media specialists to complete professional development related to media literacy education
sponsored.sum: Requires teachers and library media specialists to complete professional development related to media literacy education; directs the department of education to develop model media literacy education and CTLE requirements related to media literacy education.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to appoint a media literacy advisory group to study the teaching of media literacy; requires such group to survey all school districts
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to appoint a media literacy advisory group to study the teaching of media literacy; requires such group to survey all school districts on the media literacy practices of and the current media literacy resources available to each district, to inquire how districts are currently integrating digital citizenship and media literacy education in their curriculum.

sponsored.t: Requires pre-admission notification of policies authorizing the refusal to follow directives in health care proxies that are contrary to a hospital's operating principles
sponsored.sum: Requires pre-admission notification of policies authorizing the refusal to follow directives in health care proxies that are contrary to a hospital's operating principles.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing a tax credit for spay or neuter services
sponsored.sum: Provides a tax credit for spay or neuter services.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting animal hatching projects in schools
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting school districts, school principals, administrators, or teachers from requiring, permitting, or conducting a lesson or experimental study using an animal in a hatching project.

sponsored.t: Regulates the sale of oral nicotine pouches
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulating the sale of oral nicotine pouches.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a mollusk shell recycling tax credit
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mollusk shell recycling tax credit; directs DEC to promulgate necessary regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility of tax credits based on a corporation's record of sexual harassment, sexual assault, and discrimination among and between employees of such corporation
sponsored.sum: Requires the development and implementation of written workplace sexual harassment, sexual assault, and discrimination policies by corporations; requires reporting and eligibility for tax credits based on a corporation's record of sexual harassment, sexual assault, and discrimination among and between employees of such corporation; requires the division of human rights to promulgate standards relating to eligibility for state tax credits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of online advertisements by electronic cigarette companies
sponsored.sum: Requires that all companies that sell electronic cigarettes shall annually disclose to the commissioner of health their online advertising expenditures from the previous fiscal year; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to appoint a media literacy advisory committee to study the teaching of media literacy; requires such committee to annually review policy on media literacy
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to appoint a media literacy advisory committee to study the teaching of media literacy; requires such committee to annually review policy on media literacy.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "total access to menstrual products (TAMP) act"
sponsored.sum: Requires that all female-designated and gender-neutral bathrooms in the state of New York provide menstrual products at no cost.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of smart access systems and the information that may be gathered from such systems
sponsored.sum: Relates to limitations on the use of smart access systems; restricts information that may be gathered on lessees, tenants, owners or guests.

sponsored.t: Relates to the provision of legal representation to certain persons in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings
sponsored.sum: Requires counties and/or cities to establish a plan for providing legal counsel to persons who are defendants or respondents in eviction, ejectment and foreclosure proceedings and who are financially unable to obtain counsel; defines eligible person as one whose gross individual income is not in excess of one hundred twenty-five percent of the federal income official poverty line; requires the state to match dollar for dollar the amount counties appropriate for their plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to securing payment of wages for work already performed; creates an employee lien
sponsored.sum: Relates to securing payment of wages for work already performed; creates a lien remedy for all employees; provides grounds for attachment; relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft; relates to rights for victims of wage theft to hold the ten members with the largest ownership interests in a company personally liable for wage theft.

sponsored.t: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to post signage over mass transit seats indicating that individuals should give up their seats for the elderly, pregnant and disabled
sponsored.sum: Requires the metropolitan transportation authority to post signage over mass transit seats indicating that individuals should give up their seats for the elderly, pregnant and disabled; provides such signage shall be conspicuously posted and visible from all seats; provides costs and expenses to be paid through appropriated funds.

sponsored.t: Creates a task force on animal laws
sponsored.sum: Creates a task force on animal laws; requires reporting to the governor and legislature of recommendations on how to increase statewide uniformity of such.

sponsored.t: Provides for the licensing of genetic counselors; creates the state board for genetic counseling
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing of genetic counselors; creates the state board for genetic counseling.

sponsored.t: Prohibits tail docking of cattle
sponsored.sum: Prohibits tail docking of cattle.

sponsored.t: Relates to the statute of limitations for actions based on employment discrimination
sponsored.sum: Relates to the statute of limitations for actions based on discriminatory practices in employment; establishes action must be commenced within six years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the supervision of certain limited profit housing companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to the supervision of certain limited profit housing companies.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale or distribution of electronic cigarettes lacking federal food and drug administration premarket order of approval
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or distribution of electronic cigarettes lacking federal food and drug administration premarket order of approval; imposes penalties of not less than ten thousand dollars for violations.

sponsored.t: Increases the tax imposed on the sale of certain tobacco products and the retail sale of vapor products
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax imposed on the sale of certain tobacco products from 75% to 129% and increases the tax imposed on the retail sale of vapor products from 20% to 48%; makes conforming changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing sexual harassment training to undergraduate and graduate student interns
sponsored.sum: Requires all colleges and universities to provide sexual harassment training to undergraduate and graduate student interns.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of serious offense and felony offenses against animals for purposes of possession of a firearm
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of serious offense and felony offenses against animals for purposes of possession of a firearm.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibitions on single-use plastic straws and stirrers in restaurants
sponsored.sum: Provides that restaurants may provide single-use plastic straws to customers when explicitly requested by the customer; prohibits single-use plastic stirrers.

sponsored.t: Requires electronic cigarettes and e-liquids to have nicotine levels which automatically taper off
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to establish nicotine levels for electronic cigarettes and e-liquids which automatically taper in nicotine strength in amounts and at certain time intervals; requires manufacturers to only manufacture, cause to be manufactured, or sold, in this state, any electronic cigarette or e-liquid unless such product automatically tapers in nicotine strength in amounts and at certain time intervals as determined by the department of health.

sponsored.t: Relates to instruction in food, agriculture and nutrition in elementary and high school
sponsored.sum: Relates to instruction in food, agriculture and nutrition in elementary and high school; contents may be varied to meet the needs of particular school districts; need not be uniform throughout the state; school districts shall utilize either the curriculum for health education instruction regarding food, agriculture and nutrition prescribed by the commissioner or a course approved by the commissioner in accordance with criteria established by the commissioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory biennial CPR training for home care service workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to mandatory biennial CPR training for home care service workers.

sponsored.t: Requires coverage for delivery through store and forward technology
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to provide coverage for delivery through store and forward technology; requires prescription drug policies to cover the cost of contraceptive care delivered via telemedicine.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing the state excise tax on cigarettes
sponsored.sum: Increases the state excise tax on cigarettes.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all parties to an annulment or divorce to remove religious barriers to remarriage
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring all parties to an annulment or divorce to remove religious barriers to remarriage within ninety days of filing for such annulment or divorce or be subject to a fine of twenty-five hundred dollars per week.

sponsored.t: Requires the location of a proposed charter school be included in the charter application
sponsored.sum: Requires the location of a proposed charter school be included in the charter application.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a person convicted of violating "Buster's Law" from owning or possessing a companion animal
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a person convicted of "Buster's Law" from owning or possessing a companion animal unless authorized by court order, after appropriate psychiatric or psychological testing.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of crime database of all convictions of animal cruelty
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a crime database of all convictions in New York state of animal cruelty, fighting, neglect, abandonment and mistreatment; makes such crime database available to all law enforcement entities, district attorneys, duly incorporated humane societies, societies for the prevention of cruelty to animals, dog or cat protective associations and animal control officers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of leg-gripping traps
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of leg-gripping traps.

sponsored.t: Confinement of animals for food producing purposes
sponsored.sum: Pertains to confinement of animals for food producing purposes; prohibits any person to tether or confine any pig during pregnancy, calf raised for veal, or egg-laying hen who is kept on a farm for all or the majority of any day in a manner that prevents such animal from lying down, standing up and fully extending its limbs and turning around freely; establishes that commission of such crime shall constitute a class A misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a period not to exceed one year and/or fine not to exceed $1,000.

sponsored.t: Relates to imposing a commercial vacancy tax
sponsored.sum: Imposes a commercial vacancy tax on vacant or abandoned commercial storefronts located in a city with a population of one million or more of one percent of the assessed value of the property.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a valid prescription in order to purchase, obtain or use an electronic cigarette; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires a prescription from a licensed physician in order to obtain an electronic cigarette.

sponsored.t: Relates to drugged driving
sponsored.sum: Relates to driving while ability is impaired by drugs.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting support to a vulnerable elderly person testifying in grand jury proceedings
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting support to a vulnerable elderly person testifying in grand jury proceedings; allows a social worker or informal caregiver to accompany a vulnerable elderly person testifying in a grand jury proceeding, concerning any type of offense, provided that the district attorney consents.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting employers from certain monitoring activities of employees working at home
sponsored.sum: Prohibits employers from requiring or requesting employees working at home to install monitoring software on the personal electronic device of such employee, limits monitoring on an electronic device provided by the employer to the website browsing history of such employee, and prohibits an employer from requiring an employee to leave a camera on while such employee is working from home; provided, however, an employer may require an employee to utilize a video communication program for work-related activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the procedure for filling a vacancy in the office of state senator or in the office of member of assembly
sponsored.sum: Relates to the procedure for filling a vacancy in the office of state senator or in the office of member of assembly; allows for independent nominating petitions to be presented and provides for a special election to be held forty-five days from the date of the governor making a proclamation for a special election.

sponsored.t: Revises proceedings to recover possession to prevent avoidable eviction and resulting homelessness; requires improved notice to the respondent
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Revises proceedings to recover possession of premises located in a multiple dwelling; requires premises to be registered with the local agency responsible for code enforcement; requires petition shall be stated in plain language and include notice of the rights of the respondent and a statement of any outstanding code violations on the premises and whether rent payments from a public assistance office is being withheld therefor; provides civil penalties for willful misstatements on such petition.

sponsored.t: Relates to the taking of wildlife without a permit
sponsored.sum: Relates to the taking of wildlife without a permit; takings may only be done subject to regulations promulgated by the department; regulations shall incorporate the recommendations of the most recent guidelines on euthanasia of the American Veterinary Medical Association; provides that the taking method selected shall be the least stressful, quickest and most painless to the animal available while protecting human health and safety.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals in the presence of a child
sponsored.sum: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals in the presence of a child; increases the potential term of imprisonment from two to four years when such crime is committed in the presence of a child; defines presence of a child.

sponsored.t: Legalizes adult possession and use of certain natural plant or fungus-based hallucinogens
sponsored.sum: Legalizes adult possession and use of certain natural plant or fungus-based hallucinogens; grants certain protections for individuals lawfully using such hallucinogens; removes such hallucinogens from the list of schedule I controlled substances; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to notifying persons renewing their license of new traffic related laws
sponsored.sum: Relates to notifying persons renewing their license of new traffic related laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the tenancy deposit protection program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the tenancy deposit protection program; requires the commissioner of housing and community renewal to establish a program to hold security deposits in third-party accounts and create a dispute resolution process regarding the withholding of security deposits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the approval of certain public authorities contracts by the state comptroller
sponsored.sum: Relates to the approval of certain public authorities' contracts by the state comptroller.

sponsored.t: Prohibits tethering, restraining, caging or penning of dogs outside between the hours of 7 p.m. to 6 a.m.
sponsored.sum: Prohibits tethering, restraining, caging or penning of dogs outdoors between the hours of 7 p.m. to 6 a.m.; provides dogs may be tethered outdoors between the hours of 6 a.m. and 7 p.m. to a stationary object or a pen or cage in a sized pen or cage four times the height and length of said dog.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for the cost of veterinary services
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for the cost of veterinary services up to two thousand dollars per year.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement of costs associated with capture and return rehabilitation of animals escaped from slaughterhouses
sponsored.sum: Requires the owner of any place or establishment where animals or fowls are slaughtered or butchered for food to reimburse costs associated with capture and return or rescue and rehabilitation of escaped animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to witnesses to a health care proxy and the crime of forgery in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to witnesses to a health care proxy; changes the witness requirement for the health care proxy from two adult witnesses to one adult witness; makes an exception for persons who reside in mental health facilities by requiring such persons to have two adult witnesses; includes falsely making or altering a health care proxy within the crime of forgery in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to the order of names on ballots for special elections
sponsored.sum: Orders the names on ballots for special elections in the same manner as ordered for general and primary elections.

sponsored.t: Requires the installation of air quality monitors in all subway stations
sponsored.sum: Requires the installation of air quality monitors in all subway stations; requires data from the air quality monitors to be accessible to the public; requires remedial action to improve air quality when it is found to exceed safe levels.

sponsored.t: Relates to pet insurance
sponsored.sum: Regulates the issuance of pet insurance policies covering veterinary expenses.

sponsored.t: Provides course work and training in HIV and STI testing
sponsored.sum: Requires every physician, physician assistant, specialist assistant, registered nurse and licensed practical nurse to complete course work or training regarding human immunodeficiency virus and sexually transmitted infections testing and the elements of sexual health including sexual orientation and gender identity.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring that attorneys be available to parents of minors and requiring that all interactions with children by child protective services and the administration for children's services are videotaped
sponsored.sum: Requires that attorneys be available to parents of minors; requires that all interactions with children by child protective services and the administration for children's services are videotaped.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of performance-enhancing drugs in horseracing
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of performance-enhancing drugs in horseracing.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the department of labor to conduct a study on the potential impact of driverless vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of labor to conduct a study on the potential impact of driverless vehicles on occupations and employment.

sponsored.t: Repeals subdivision 4 of section 1399-m-1 of the public health law, relating to exemptions for certain vapor products dealers from the prohibition of selling flavored products
sponsored.sum: Relates to exemptions for certain vapor products dealers from the prohibition of selling flavored products.

sponsored.t: Increases certain penalties for violating the prohibition of animal fighting and for aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Increases certain penalties for violating the prohibition of animal fighting and for aggravated cruelty to animals; requires a psychiatric evaluation for defendants convicted of aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to repeat offenders of driving accidents
sponsored.sum: Relates to repeat offenders of driving accidents.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of birds by pet dealers when such birds have not yet been fully weaned
sponsored.sum: Relates to the sale of birds by pet dealers when such birds have not yet been fully weaned.

sponsored.t: Requires courses of study in private schools in the prevention of child sexual exploitation and child sexual abuse
sponsored.sum: Requires courses of study in private schools in the prevention of child sexual exploitation and child sexual abuse for pupils in grades K-8.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain accounts established by not-for-profit corporations from application to the satisfaction of money judgments for bankruptcy purposes
sponsored.sum: Exempts retirement accounts established by not-for-profit corporations from application to the satisfaction of money judgments for bankruptcy purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a tax credit for the adoption of household pets from animal shelter or humane society
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for the adoption of household pets from animal shelters or humane societies; up to $100 per animal with a maximum of three household pets.

sponsored.t: Relates to women's health in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to women's health in correctional facilities; establishes a women's health education program; requires HIV and STD testing to be offered to incarcerated individuals; provides pregnant incarcerated individuals with access to prenatal vitamins as well as a specialized diet tailored to pregnancy needs; requires a study and report on women's health in prison.

sponsored.t: Directs the secretary of state to prepare and distribute to cities, towns and villages criterion for a comprehensive outdoor lighting ordinance
sponsored.sum: Directs the secretary of state to prepare and distribute to cities, towns and villages criterion for a comprehensive outdoor lighting ordinance; updates general lighting restrictions.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for the legal ownership of a companion animal
sponsored.sum: Allows a court to determine legal ownership of a companion animal, taking into consideration the well-being of the companion animal, during proceedings for dissolution of marriage, legal separation and proceedings commenced by individuals who have both resided with the companion animal.

sponsored.t: Requires the installation and use of surveillance cameras in all racetracks
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the installation and use of surveillance cameras in all racetracks; provides cameras shall be capable of monitoring human and equine traffic in and out of individual stalls, barns and surrounding areas; provides video footage shall be available for review for no less than three years from the date of surveillance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a court appointed advocate for animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a court appointed advocate for animals.

sponsored.t: Requires sexual harassment training for hotel and motel employees
sponsored.sum: Requires sexual harassment training for hotel and motel employees; requires operators to certify to the department that they have conducted sexual harassment training; provides such training every two years for employees; requires "know your rights" brochure and employee bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for metropolitan transportation authority hearings for proposed fare increases, major reductions of transportation and/or major service changes
sponsored.sum: Requires the MTA to hold hearings in each county affected by proposed fare increases, major reductions of transportation and/or major service changes; does not apply to standard seasonal or holiday adjustments, temporary changes due to routine maintenance and/or temporary changes in response to emergency situations; requires the authority to hold a hearing in each county of a service area that is affected by the proposed change(s) in fares or services, provided that such hearings be limited to one hearing per calendar day.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of electronic cigarettes that contains certain toxic metals and requires the department of health to study the long term health effects of using electronic cigarettes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of electronic cigarettes that contain certain toxic metals; requires the department of health to establish a list of prohibited toxic metals; requires the department of health to study the long term health effects of using electronic cigarettes.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing for cage-free egg production
sponsored.sum: Requires a farm owner or operator that produces shell eggs or liquid eggs for human consumption to confine egg-laying hens in a cage-free housing system.

sponsored.t: Increases penalties for owners of rent-regulated property who overcharge tenants
sponsored.sum: Increases penalties for owners of rent-regulated property who overcharge tenants.

sponsored.t: Modifies the offense of forcible touching by removing the element of the actor's intent
sponsored.sum: Modifies the offense of forcible touching by removing the element of the actor's intent, including the intent to degrade or abuse another person.

sponsored.t: Requires all colleges with onsite housing to provide and maintain opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires all colleges with onsite housing to provide and maintain opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting requirements for certain state funds
sponsored.sum: Expands reporting requirements for certain state funds.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage for early egg and peanut allergen introduction dietary supplements for infants at no cost
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance coverage for early egg and peanut allergen introduction dietary supplements for infants at no cost.

sponsored.t: Prohibits private colleges from collecting financial information from a student's non-custodial parent; requires that private colleges use student financial aid formulas that are arrived at independently
sponsored.sum: Prohibits independent higher education institutions from collecting financial information from a student's or prospective student's non-custodial parent; requires that private colleges use student financial aid formulas that are arrived at independently, without coordination with outside standard setting organizations.

sponsored.t: Establishes an illegal cannabis retailer directory
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of cannabis management to establish an illegal cannabis retailer directory.

sponsored.t: Requires NYCHA to establish and maintain a vacancy database
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city housing authority to establish and maintain a vacancy database.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the declawing and descenting of ferrets
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the declawing and descenting of ferrets except when necessary for a therapeutic purpose and performed by a licensed veterinarian.

sponsored.t: Expands the requirements for teaching humane education to secondary school students
sponsored.sum: Expands the requirements for teaching humane education of animals to secondary school students; requires verification of compliance.

sponsored.t: Initiates a four-year moratorium on privatization voting by Mitchell-Lama building shareholders
sponsored.sum: Initiates a four year moratorium on privatization voting by Mitchell-Lama building shareholders between failed dissolution votes.

sponsored.t: Requires that bidders and all others seeking state contracts disclose their percentage and number of female executives and board members
sponsored.sum: Requires that bidders and all others seeking state contracts disclose their percentage and number of female executives and board members and their aspirations to include more female members.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the crimes of cruelty to animals to threaten, intimidate or harass in the second degree and first degree
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of cruelty to animals to threaten, intimidate or harass in the second degree and cruelty to animals to threaten, intimidate or harass in the first degree when in the presence of a minor child.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption for drugs and medicines for companion and farm animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing an exemption for drugs and medicines for companion and farm animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the department of labor to conduct a study on the impact of job automation
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of labor to conduct a study on the impact of job automation on the workforce in New York state.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the ten year time period from the crime of persistent sexual abuse
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing the ten year time period from the crime of persistent sexual abuse.

sponsored.t: Prohibits vivisection at colleges, universities, professional, proprietary or graduate schools where a scientifically and educationally satisfactory method or strategy exists
sponsored.sum: Prohibits vivisection at colleges, universities, professional, proprietary or graduate schools in the state where a scientifically and educationally satisfactory method or strategy exists; defines vivisection to mean experimentation through surgery on a living organism to view living internal structure.

sponsored.t: Requires display of building numbers on all buildings to which numbers have been assigned
sponsored.sum: Requires plainly legible display of building numbers on all buildings to which numbers have been assigned; provides for a fine for violations of such requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disqualification of school bus drivers for certain offenses involving children
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disqualification of school bus drivers for certain offenses involving children.

sponsored.t: Prohibits publicly owned treatment works from accepting wastewater associated with the exploration, delineation, development, or production of natural gas
sponsored.sum: Prohibits publicly owned treatment works from accepting wastewater associated with the exploration, delineation, development, or production of natural gas from high-volume hydraulic fracturing; provides exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the permitted voluntary dissolution of a mutual company
sponsored.sum: Relates to the permitted voluntary dissolution of a mutual company.

sponsored.t: Provides that landlord's request for information regarding request to sublet shall be on forms prepared by housing agency
sponsored.sum: Requires the division of housing and community renewal to promulgate forms which a landlord of a rent regulated unit in a building with four or more such units shall be required to use when requesting additional information from a tenant who has made a request to sublet.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring a study to determine the effects that exposure to long range acoustic devices have on an individual's hearing
sponsored.sum: Requires a study by the department of health to determine the effects that exposure to long range acoustic devices have on an individual's hearing.

sponsored.t: Relates to the labeling of electronic cigarette products and packaging
sponsored.sum: Provides that every package containing an electronic cigarette and the electronic cigarette itself, as defined in subdivision thirteen of section thirteen hundred ninety-nine-aa of the public health law, sold, offered for sale or otherwise distributed without charge within this state, shall be designed by the department of health and such package containing an electronic cigarette and the electronic cigarette itself shall include printed thereon or attached thereto a health warning and disclaimer label designed by the department of health.

sponsored.t: Provides that in New York city, the rent following the dissolution date shall be the last rent authorized for the affected dwelling
sponsored.sum: Provides that in cities with a population of one million or more, the rent following the dissolution date of Mitchell-Lama developments shall be the last rent authorized for the affected dwelling.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the state's participation in artificial pheasant propagation activities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the state's participation in artificial pheasant propagation activities; closes any state-owned or operated pheasant production facility.

sponsored.t: Confinement of certain animals for food producing purposes
sponsored.sum: Pertains to confinement of certain animals for food producing purposes; prohibits any person to tether or confine any pig during pregnancy or calf raised for veal for all or the majority of any day in a manner that prevents such animal from lying down, standing up and fully extending its limbs and turning around freely; establishes that commission of such crime shall constitute a class A misdemeanor punishable by imprisonment for a period not to exceed one year and/or fine not to exceed $1,000.

sponsored.t: Criminalizes knowingly causing a minor to attend a place where exhibition of animal fighting is being conducted
sponsored.sum: Criminalizes knowingly causing a minor to attend a place where exhibition of animal fighting is being conducted, establishes such offense is considered a misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Requires owners to provide prospective lessees with notification where lead-based paint or lead contaminated dust has been found in the rental unit
sponsored.sum: Requires owners to provide prospective lessees with notification where lead-based paint or lead contaminated dust has been found and any and all abatement measures that have been taken in the rental unit.

sponsored.t: Provides a rent increase exemption to persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing a rent increase exemption to persons with disabilities.
