sponsored.t: Relates to state policy regarding the preservation of the unique qualities of the nighttime sky
sponsored.sum: Relates to state policy regarding the preservation of the unique qualities of the nighttime sky.

sponsored.t: Relates to defining the practice of esthetics to include eyebrow threading services
sponsored.sum: Relates to defining the practice of esthetics to include eyebrow threading services.

sponsored.t: Prohibits rental car companies and used car companies from renting, selling or leasing vehicles that have been recalled due to safety risks
sponsored.sum: Prohibits rental car companies and used car companies from renting, selling or leasing vehicles that have been recalled due to safety risks.

sponsored.t: Prohibits disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the disclosure of highway, bridge, tunnel and other thoroughfare toll and transit records, with exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the menstrual product safety and research act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the menstrual product safety and research act and its creation of a research program to determine the risks posed from potential toxins in menstrual products.

sponsored.t: Permits the witnessing and solemnization of a marriage ceremony and the issuance of a marriage license application or marriage license to be performed utilizing audio-video technology
sponsored.sum: Permits the witnessing and solemnization of a marriage ceremony and the issuance of a marriage license application or marriage license to be performed utilizing audio-video technology provided certain conditions are met.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the use of wastewater from high-volume hydraulic fracturing for road and land spreading
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of wastewater from high-volume hydraulic fracturing for road and land spreading, for dust control or de-icing.

sponsored.t: Requires certain technology on cigarette tax stamps to prevent counterfeiting
sponsored.sum: Requires the use of color shifting dyes, unique serial numbers, tamper-evident surface cuts, and stamp/meter impressions that can be read by scanning devices on cigarette tax stamps to prevent counterfeiting.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authenticity, attribution and authorship of fine works of art
sponsored.sum: Relates to the authenticity, attribution and authorship of fine works of art; defines the term authenticator and stipulates that in a civil action regarding authenticity, the claimant must specify with particularity the facts and prove the elements by clear and convincing evidence; entitles the authenticator to recover reasonable attorneys' fees and expenses if he/she prevails.

sponsored.t: Authorizes administrative enforcement of state and local housing maintenance laws
sponsored.sum: Authorizes localities to establish administrative proceedings for the enforcement of state and local housing maintenance codes; permits administratively imposed penalties to be docketed and enforced in the same manner as a judgment in a civil action without further judicial proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting wildlife and maintaining safety
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting wildlife and maintaining safety; necessitates written notification before a nuisance wildlife control operator undertakes any control measures.

sponsored.t: Relates to modifying the penalties associated with passing a stopped school bus to include a mandatory driver education course
sponsored.sum: Relates to modifying the penalties associated with passing a stopped school bus to include a mandatory driver education course for each offense after a second conviction if recommended by the court.

sponsored.t: Relates to allergy awareness and training in restaurants
sponsored.sum: Relates to allergy awareness and training in restaurants; requires allergen awareness training; requires certification within thirty days after hire date.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring landlords to allow for the estate of a deceased tenant to enter the property for sixty days following the death of the tenant
sponsored.sum: Requires landlords to allow for the estate of a deceased tenant to enter the property for sixty days following the death of the tenant.

sponsored.t: Creates privacy standards for electronic health products and services
sponsored.sum: Creates privacy standards for electronic health products and services; requires consent to be given for the collection and/or sharing of personal health information or other personal data.

sponsored.t: Requires the state board of elections to develop a program to be administered by all boards of elections to notify voters of certain information where their area has been redistricted
sponsored.sum: Requires the state board of elections to develop a program to be administered by all boards of elections to notify voters of certain information where their area has been redistricted.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of certain residential dwellings by tenants who left the dwelling temporarily due to the health impacts of COVID-19
sponsored.sum: Provides that a tenant who has left a residential dwelling unit between the dates of March 12, 2020 and January 1, 2022 due to the health impacts of COVID-19 in the city of New York, who is a senior citizen or disabled person, and who asserts an intent to return to the housing accommodation shall be deemed to be occupying the unit as such tenant's residence.

sponsored.t: Requires notice of enforcement of a lien on goods in a self-storage facility to be sent to an emergency contact designated by the occupant
sponsored.sum: Requires notice of enforcement of a lien on goods in a self-storage facility to be sent to an emergency contact designated by the occupant in a manner similar to the occupant; requires notice to update information on occupancy agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to codifying animal cruelty laws under the penal law; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to codifying animal cruelty laws under the penal law; makes conforming technical changes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the overpayment of insurance claims
sponsored.sum: Prevents health plans from engaging in overpayment recovery efforts that include contacting the patient to seek reimbursement for such overpayment of claims.

sponsored.t: Relates to allowing a jury instruction stating biometric evidence shall not be dispositive in the jury's decision
sponsored.sum: Relates to allowing a jury instruction stating biometric evidence shall not be dispositive in the jury's decision.

sponsored.t: Provides for rules and regulations for state aid reimbursement for the purchase of opioid antagonists by municipalities
sponsored.sum: Provides for rules and regulations for state aid reimbursement under article six of the public health law for the purchase of opioid antagonists by municipalities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of facial recognition and biometric information for determining probable cause
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of facial recognition and biometric information as the sole factor in determining the existence of probable cause to place in custody or arrest an individual.

sponsored.t: Relates to waivers of rent adjustments attributable to major capital improvements
sponsored.sum: Relates to waivers of rent adjustments attributable to major capital improvements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the remediation and prevention of indoor mold
sponsored.sum: Relates to the remediation and prevention of indoor mold; requires notification to prospective lessees.

sponsored.t: Removes provisions prohibiting N.Y. city from strengthening rent regulation laws to provide more comprehensive coverage than state laws
sponsored.ls: Local Emergency Housing Rent Control Act
sponsored.sum: Removes provisions that prohibit cities of one million or more from strengthening rent regulation laws to provide more comprehensive coverage than state laws.

sponsored.t: Relates to making certain housing programs available regardless of immigration status
sponsored.sum: Relates to making certain housing programs available regardless of immigration status; provides that local social services districts in a city with a population of five million or more shall be permitted to offer certain housing programs to individuals or families who would be eligible but for a federal law restricting eligibility based on immigration.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement that rent arrears be repaid
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that rent arrears be repaid for social services districts located in a municipality with a population of five million or more.

sponsored.t: Establishes a residential condominium owner's bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Enacts a bill of rights for owners of residential condominium units to provide fair and equitable treatment of all unit owners; directs the attorney general to promulgate a handbook summary of the rights of unit owners vis-a-vis condominium associations and the procedures and processes available to unit owners to enforce such rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to rent registration statements filed by a limited liability company
sponsored.sum: Requires that any limited liability company who files a rent registration statement shall include a list of all members of such limited liability company and each member's ownership interest.

sponsored.t: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district
sponsored.sum: Requires shelter allowances be set at up to one hundred percent of the fair market rent for the local social services district.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timely cashing of rent checks
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timely cashing of rent checks; requires a landlord to cash a rent check provided by a tenant in their possession within thirty days after the check is postmarked.

sponsored.t: Designates rescue cats as the official state cat
sponsored.sum: Designates rescue cats as the official state cat; establishes that a rescue cat is a cat of any breed or mixture of breeds rescued and adopted from an animal shelter or rescue group located in the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to financial statements for assessments of condos, cooperative buildings and cooperative communities
sponsored.sum: Relates to financial statements for assessments of condos, cooperative buildings and cooperative communities; requires financial statements to be prepared using GAAP; requires auditing for certain buildings by CPAs.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of agriculture and markets to establish a grading system
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of agriculture and markets to establish a grading system for retail food stores, food service establishments and food warehouses.

sponsored.t: Imposes penalties for non-compliance of division of housing and community renewal orders
sponsored.sum: Imposes penalties for non-compliance of DHCR orders by owners of multiple dwelling units; provides a fine of $5,000 for each instance of non-compliance.

sponsored.t: Relates to services for victims of domestic violence; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to services for victims of domestic violence; provides that the department of social services shall ensure there is sufficient access to domestic violence services in every county; eliminates per diem reimbursement rates for domestic violence programs.

sponsored.t: Requires that any disposition of land or buildings by the New York City Housing Authority be subject to and comply with the provisions of New York City's Uniform Land Use Review Procedure
sponsored.sum: Requires that any disposition of land or buildings by the New York City Housing Authority be subject to and comply with the provisions of New York City's Uniform Land Use Review Procedure.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of DNA phenotyping in criminal prosecutions and proceedings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of DNA phenotyping in criminal prosecutions and proceedings.

sponsored.t: Requires a school library media specialist in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high and senior high school
sponsored.sum: Requires a school library media specialist in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high and senior high school with one such specialist being employed full-time in schools with more than five hundred students and two such specialists being employed full-time in schools with more than two thousand students.

sponsored.t: Relates to information available pertaining to rental histories of rent-stabilized units through FOIL applications
sponsored.sum: Relates to information available pertaining to rental histories of rent stabilized units through FOIL applications by the NYS division of housing and community renewal.

sponsored.t: Allows voters to take photographs of themselves and their ballot, or absentee ballot, while in a privacy booth, and to share and disseminate such photographs on social media
sponsored.sum: Allows voters to take photographs of themselves and their ballot, or absentee ballot, while in a privacy booth, and to share and disseminate such photographs on social media.

sponsored.t: Requires absentee ballots to be provided to all qualified voters; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires absentee ballots to be provided to all qualified voters; relates to the delivery of absentee ballots.

sponsored.t: Relates to the admissibility of certain testimony and evidence by a person alleging discrimination
sponsored.sum: Permits the admissibility of testimony that a person reported acts of discrimination to another person in a civil trial under the human rights law, including the contents of such report.

sponsored.t: Requires companies aided by loans under Mitchell-Lama to notify tenants of buy out from mortgage options and a report by the commissioner or supervising agency
sponsored.sum: Requires companies aided by loans under Mitchell-Lama to notify tenants of such housing of the possibility of buyout from mortgages held which would potentially result in rent increases not later than twelve months prior to proposed dissolution; provides such notice shall inform tenants of the nature of the action, the date intended, the applicable laws and a summary of the potential consequences including expenses and rent increases which may be charged; requires the commissioner or supervising agency to prepare a report to be made available to the tenants of the project.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the nonemergency application of pesticide or lawn care pesticide within any municipal park lands and lands under the jurisdiction of the state office of parks, recreation and historic preservation
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the nonemergency application of pesticide or lawn care pesticide within any municipal park lands and lands under the jurisdiction of the state office of parks, recreation and historic preservation; requires notice of pesticide application.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prohibition of certain acts in rodeos
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain acts in rodeos; imposes penalties for the violation of such acts.

sponsored.t: Creates the lymphedema and lymphatic diseases research grants program and creates the lymphatic disease research and education fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the lymphedema and lymphatic diseases research grants program; provides such grants, not to exceed $50,000, would be awarded on a competitive basis to biomedical research institutions conducting direct research related to lymphedema and lymphatic disease.

sponsored.t: Relates to professional misconduct of medical professionals
sponsored.sum: Relates to professional misconduct of medical professionals involving felonies committed in the course of the licensee's medical practice; provides for license revocation.

sponsored.t: Initiates a five-year moratorium on the dissolution of any urban rental Mitchell-Lama company and establishes a Mitchell-Lama housing program study
sponsored.sum: Initiates a five-year moratorium on the dissolution of any urban rental Mitchell-Lama company; establishes a Mitchell-Lama housing program study.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjournments for right to counsel
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that in any jurisdiction in which a party is eligible under local law for free legal counsel, if such party has in good faith attempted to secure such counsel and is unable to obtain counsel through no fault of their own, the court shall adjourn the trial of the issue for consecutive periods of not less than fourteen days each until the party is able to secure counsel.

sponsored.t: Relates to grounds where no landlord-tenant relationship exists
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to grounds where no landlord-tenant relationship exists.

sponsored.t: Requires comprehensive training for school bus drivers and school bus attendants in the discouragement, prevention and detection of harassment, bullying and discrimination
sponsored.sum: Requires comprehensive training at least one time per year for school bus drivers and school bus attendants in the discouragement, prevention and detection of harassment, bullying and discrimination.

sponsored.t: Establishes the homeless protection act which designates certain offenses against homeless persons as hate crimes
sponsored.sum: Establishes the homeless protection act which designates certain offenses against homeless persons as hate crimes; includes the definition of homelessness.

sponsored.t: Prohibits landlords from refusing to deal with certain people solely because those people were involved in prior summary proceedings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits landlords from refusing to deal with certain people solely because those people were involved in prior summary proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring boards of elections to include the number of registration forms distributed to and returned by each agency assisting with voter registration in their annual reports
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring boards of elections to include the number of registration forms distributed to and returned by each agency assisting with voter registration in their annual reports; provides personally identifiable information about the registrants shall not be collected or included in the report.

sponsored.t: Relates to the standard of proof for determination of eligibility for public housing based upon remaining family member status
sponsored.sum: Relates to the standard of proof for determination of eligibility for public housing based upon remaining family member status.

sponsored.t: Relates to state assistance for food and vet expenses for guide dogs, hearing dogs and service dogs of individuals qualifying for social services; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to state assistance for food and vet expenses for guide dogs, hearing dogs and service dogs of individuals qualifying for social services; requires regulations set an amount of no less than $50 a month; clarifies that service dogs do not have to be certified to qualify for such benefits.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale or provision of any quantity of electronic liquid used to refill an electronic cigarette or cartridge
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale or provision of any quantity of electronic liquid used to refill an electronic cigarette or cartridge.

sponsored.t: Limits a candidate to one authorized committee per election; defines "multi-candidate committee"; provides that such a committee may not be an authorized committee
sponsored.sum: Limits a candidate for public office to one authorized committee per election; defines the term "multi-candidate committee" and provides that such a committee may not be authorized by a candidate.

sponsored.t: Creates the toxics information clearinghouse
sponsored.sum: Creates the toxic information clearinghouse; provides substances hazardous to public health, safety or the environment that have been identified or listed as a hazardous waste in regulations promulgated pursuant to section 27-0903 or 37-0103 of the environmental conservation law; provides chemical hazard traits and environmental and toxicological end-point data.

sponsored.t: Requires the establishment of a plant-based agriculture grant program
sponsored.sum: Requires the establishment of a plant-based agriculture grant program to assist small and medium-sized farms transition to plant-based agriculture.

sponsored.t: Removes statute of limitations for certain civil actions related to child sexual assault offenses
sponsored.sum: Removes statute of limitations for certain civil actions related to child sexual assault offenses.

sponsored.t: Provides for the determination of legal regulated base date rent for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Provides that the determination of legal regulated base date rent at the four-year lookback shall be determined by either the survey sampling method or the default method if there is fraud.

sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for failure to comply with maintenance and reporting of vacant and abandoned properties, and reporting and release of information
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to penalties for failure to comply with maintenance and reporting of vacant and abandoned properties, and reporting and release of information; provides for the sharing of information between municipalities; provides for enforcement for failure to report on abandoned and vacant properties.

sponsored.t: Sets out the procedures and requirements for special elections
sponsored.sum: Sets out the procedures and requirements for special elections; implements a timetable for the special primary and special election, including the number of signatures required for the petition.

sponsored.t: Relates to effectiveness of judgments entered by the New York City environmental control board; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the eight year expiration for judgments entered by the New York City environmental control board.

sponsored.t: Provides a private right of action for nail specialists aggrieved by their employer in the case of a health and safety violation or retaliatory action
sponsored.sum: Provides a private right of action for nail specialists aggrieved by their employer in the case of a health and safety violation, unlawful retaliatory action, or general labor issues such as hours and breaks.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Big Five African Trophies Act" relating to banning the importation, transportation and possession of certain African wildlife species and products.

sponsored.t: Relates to potential tenants with a criminal history; and relates to public housing applicants with a criminal history
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting potential tenants with a criminal history; relates to protecting public housing applicants with a criminal history.

sponsored.t: Prohibits warehousing of housing accommodations and harassment of tenants; provides penalties therefor
sponsored.sum: Provides that penalties may be levied against a person who intentionally withholds a housing accommodation from the market, including for the purpose of future co-operative conversion.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the MTA's exemption from environmental quality review standards established by article 8 of the environmental conservation law
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the MTA's exemption from environmental quality review standards established by article 8 of the environmental conservation law.

sponsored.t: Relates to the liability of an employee committing an unlawful discriminatory practice
sponsored.sum: Relates to the liability of an employee committing an unlawful discriminatory practice; creates joint and several liability for employers and employees responsible for unlawful discriminatory practices.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the fraudulent use of an architect's seal by a developer and provides penalties for violations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a developer from using or displaying the seal of an architect or landscape architect on the developer's plans unless such architect or landscape architect has overseen and approved the development and creation of the plans; provides penalties for violation; and provides an enforcement mechanism.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawful tenancies under the emergency tenant protection act of 1974
sponsored.sum: Relates to unlawful tenancies under the emergency tenant protection act of 1974; prohibits owners from entering or renewing leases where such owner has reason to know that such tenant will not occupy the housing accommodation as the tenant's primary residence.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a set of media literacy standards for students in grades kindergarten through twelve
sponsored.sum: Creates a set of media literacy standards for students in grades kindergarten through twelve which focuses on internet safety, civility and digital citizenship.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing the creation of an air rights database for the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of the New York city department of finance to create an air rights database recording transfers of such unused development rights.

sponsored.t: Ensures zoning lot mergers do not create any new non-compliance with applicable, pre-existing zoning regulations
sponsored.sum: Ensures zoning lot mergers do not create any new non-compliance with applicable, pre-existing zoning regulations for multiple dwellings in a city having a population of five million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for the suspension of public assistance to owners of privately owned residential housing in New York city who are in violation of certain housing standards
sponsored.sum: Provides for the suspension of public assistance to owners of privately owned residential housing in NYC who are in violation of certain New York city department of housing preservation and development standards.

sponsored.t: Requires the coverage of alternative treatment options by the medical assistance program and private insurers
sponsored.sum: Requires that non-pharmaceutical alternative treatment options including but not limited to treatment provided by a licensed acupuncturist, licensed massage therapist, licensed chiropractor, and yoga instructor be covered by the medical assistance program and by private health insurers.

sponsored.t: Includes certain programs and facilities in the definition of provider or provider agency
sponsored.sum: Includes organizations and programs that provide community based services to individuals under twenty-one in the definition of provider or provider agency regarding the statewide central register of child abuse and maltreatment.

sponsored.t: Requires higher education research facilities to make available certain information regarding the adoption of dogs or cats
sponsored.sum: Requires higher education research facilities to make available certain information regarding the adoption of dogs or cats on their website.

sponsored.t: Establishes the crimes of sexual conduct with an animal resulting in injury or death and sexual conduct with an animal
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crimes of sexual conduct with an animal resulting in injury or death and sexual conduct with an animal; makes such crimes a class E felony and class A misdemeanor, respectively.

sponsored.t: Relates to decriminalizing the possession of buprenorphine
sponsored.sum: Decriminalizes the possession of buprenorphine from certain crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the care and collection of animals on vacant property
sponsored.sum: Relates to the care and collection of abandoned animals on vacant property; requires notification to the appropriate authorities by anyone authorized to be on vacant land where such person finds an animal which based on its physical appearance or lack of available food or water appears abandoned, within six hours of an encounter.

sponsored.t: Relates to the cleaning of playground equipment after pesticide exposure
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of environmental conservation and the department of health to establish certain standards related to the cleaning of playground equipment after pesticide exposure.

sponsored.t: Relates to removing the requirement that physical injury be caused under the crimes of aggravated sexual abuse in the third and fourth degrees
sponsored.sum: Relates to removing the requirement that physical injury be caused under the crimes of aggravated sexual abuse in the third and fourth degrees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the ability of a fare-paying passenger in a transportation network company vehicle and the driver of such vehicle to consent to sexual activity inside such vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to the ability of a fare-paying passenger in a transportation network company vehicle and the driver of such vehicle to consent to sexual activity inside such vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to a tax credit for employment of an individual who has successfully completed a judicial diversion substance abuse treatment program or graduated from drug court
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for employment of an individual who has successfully completed a judicial diversion substance abuse treatment program or graduated from drug court.

sponsored.t: Requires assisted living facilities to notify residents of changes to medical and support services 180 days prior to such changes taking effect
sponsored.sum: Requires assisted living facilities to notify residents of changes to medical and support services 180 days prior to such changes taking effect.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the definition of floor area
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of floor area and what is excluded in the measurement of floor area.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring health insurers to offer coverage of health care provided by out-of-network providers
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to offer coverage of health care provided by out-of-network providers.

sponsored.t: Relates to contact information on motor vehicle accident reports for commercial enterprises
sponsored.sum: Relates to motor vehicle accident reports; requires contact information including names, addresses, telephone numbers, and email addresses where available, for all parties and telephone numbers and email addresses where available for all witnesses, for a commercial enterprise where a vehicle or bicycle involved in an accident is operated by an employee or independent contractor of such commercial enterprise.

sponsored.t: Amends certain definitions relating to tobacco products and changes the minimum pack sizes for tobacco products and the tax amount for tobacco products
sponsored.sum: Amends certain definitions relating to tobacco products; changes the minimum pack sizes for tobacco products and the tax amount for tobacco products.

sponsored.t: Relates to dysmenorrhea and use of sick leave
sponsored.sum: Allows employees to use dysmenorrhea as a reason for use of sick leave.

sponsored.t: Requires certain school staff members to be trained in the Heimlich maneuver
sponsored.sum: Requires certain school staff members to be trained in the Heimlich maneuver and requires at least one such trained person to be present when and where students eat meals.

sponsored.t: Establishes a climate change education grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a climate change education grant program to award grants to eligible applicants to support climate change education grant programs for young people or to provide optional teacher training or professional development programs relevant to the advance of climate change literacy in young people; establishes the New York state climate change education fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an office of antibiotic resistance control and to establishing the antibiotics education fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an office of antibiotic-resistance control; establishes the antibiotics education fund; includes methicillin-resistant staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) and other antibiotic-resistant infections in the definition of airborne infectious disease.

sponsored.t: Requires the reporting and monitoring of a minor whose parent, legal guardian or care-giver of a minor is arrested or taken into custody
sponsored.sum: Requires an arresting authority to notify the local social services district when the parent, legal guardian or care-giver of a minor is arrested or taken into custody; requires the local social services district to monitor the placement of such minor.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction in anti-gun violence in all schools
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in anti-gun violence in all schools.

sponsored.t: Restricts sales tax exemptions on fur-bearing articles of clothing or footwear
sponsored.sum: Restricts sales tax exemptions on fur-bearing articles of clothing or footwear.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the breeding, sale, trade, purchase, importation, and exportation of red-eared slider turtles
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the breeding, sale, trade, purchase, importation, and exportation of red-eared slider turtles in the state; exempts certain entities and organizations.

sponsored.t: Enacts the healthy, safe and energy efficient outdoor lighting act to reduce harmful outdoor lighting
sponsored.sum: Enacts the healthy, safe and energy efficient outdoor lighting act to reduce harmful outdoor lighting; sets standards for outdoor lighting; provides for the designation of dark-sky preserves; provides for distribution to customers by electric corporations or municipalities providing electric service of an informational pamphlet relating to outdoor lighting.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the packaging, sale and distribution of confectionery and candy designed to resemble a tobacco product
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the packaging, sale and distribution of confectionery and candy designed to resemble a tobacco product.

sponsored.t: Requires the appointment of an assistant district attorney in each county to oversee the prosecution of animal crimes
sponsored.sum: Requires that the district attorney in each county appoint at least one assistant district attorney to be responsible for overseeing the prosecution of animal crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibitions on single-use food service items
sponsored.sum: Provides that restaurants and third-party food delivery services may provide single-use food service items to customers when explicitly requested by the customer; prohibits certain plastic single-use items.

sponsored.t: Establishes the housing people and animals together grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the housing people and animals together grant program to expand access for co-sheltering people experiencing homelessness and victims of domestic violence with companion animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the protection of public health from exposure to radon in natural gas
sponsored.sum: Relates to the protection of public health from exposure to radon in natural gas; requires continuous monitoring of the level of radon in the natural gas delivered; relates to a compliance assurance system; requires public reporting.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the awarding of punitive damages to persons aggrieved by sexual harassment
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the awarding of punitive damages to persons aggrieved by sexual harassment.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for leaving the scene of an accident involving an electric scooter without reporting in the first and second degrees; creates the offenses of leaving the scene of an accident involving a bicycle with electric assist without reporting in the first and second degrees.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the housing access voucher program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the housing access voucher program; provides that the commissioner of the division of housing and community renewal shall implement a program of rental assistance in the form of housing vouchers for eligible individuals and families who are homeless or who face an imminent loss of housing; provides that the commissioner shall designate housing access voucher local administrators in the state to administer the program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the inclusion of batteries used in bicycles with electric assist in the rechargeable battery recycling program
sponsored.sum: Includes batteries used in bicycles with electric assist in the rechargeable battery recycling program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the commissioner of education to conduct a study regarding ecological literacy and healthy living curriculum in schools, and to provide recommendations in a report.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of any vapor or tobacco products containing the substance ethyl menthane carboxamide
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of any vapor or tobacco products containing the substance N-Ethyl-p-menthane-3-carboxamide, which creates a cooling sensation similar to menthol.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance coverage for lymphedema
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance policies and contracts shall provide coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of lymphedema, both primary and secondary lymphedema; requires such coverage shall include benefits for equipment, supplies, devices, complex decongestive therapy and out-patient self-management training and education for the treatment of lymphedema, both primary and secondary lymphedema.

sponsored.t: Provides for a transfer fee of 75% of the fair market value in dissolution or sales of a rental project or mutual company
sponsored.sum: Provides for a transfer fee of 75% of the fair market value in dissolution or sales of a rental project or mutual company.

sponsored.t: Requires alternating high and low, two-toned signal devices on emergency services vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires alternating high and low, two-toned signal devices on emergency services vehicles in New York city.

sponsored.t: Creates an affordable housing relief fund program to preserve affordable multifamily residential properties located in New York state
sponsored.sum: Creates an affordable housing relief fund program to preserve affordable multifamily residential properties located in New York state.

sponsored.t: Establishes patient safety and quality assurance measures regarding the distribution of patient-specific medication from an insurer-designated pharmacy
sponsored.sum: Establishes patient safety and quality assurance measures regarding the distribution of patient-specific medication from an insurer-designated pharmacy; prohibits certain "brown bagging" and "white bagging" policies regarding pharmacy provided medications.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "Hunger-Free Campus Act"
sponsored.sum: Provides grants to address food insecurity among students at public institutions for higher education.

sponsored.t: Imposes civil penalties on landlords for including unenforceable provisions in residential leases
sponsored.sum: Imposes civil penalties on landlords for including unenforceable provisions in residential leases.

sponsored.t: Enacts the vicarious liability for housing discrimination act of 2025
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "vicarious liability for housing discrimination act"; imposes vicarious liability on a person for unlawful discriminatory practices related to the sale, rental, or lease of certain property by such person's agent.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a temporary state commission to rename any projects, infrastructure, facilities or sites within the state which are named after or include any reference to Robert Moses
sponsored.sum: Establishes a temporary state commission to rename any projects, infrastructure, facilities or sites within the state which are named after or include any reference to Robert Moses.

sponsored.t: Requires certain eligible persons or entities to acquire and possess opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Requires certain eligible persons or entities to acquire and possess opioid antagonists for emergency treatment of a person appearing to experience an opioid-related overdose.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pregnant persons' bill of rights
sponsored.sum: Establishes a pregnant persons' bill of rights; requires posting and disclosing such bill of rights; establishes a penalty for failure to post or disclose such bill of rights.

sponsored.t: Establishes a private right of action against gun industry members for marketing firearms and firearm related products to minors
sponsored.sum: Prohibits gun industry members from marketing firearms and firearm related products to minors; excepts instances where marketing is geared toward hunting purposes; establishes a private right of action for violations.

sponsored.t: Relates to maintaining a database of vacant residential housing units, imposing a real property tax on such vacant units, and funding affordable housing development
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of housing and community renewal to create and maintain a database of vacant residential housing units, and to create an affordable housing development program; imposes a tax on vacant residential housing units; creates an affordable housing development program fund.

sponsored.t: Places limits on rent adjustments for major capital improvements
sponsored.sum: Places limits on rent adjustments for major capital improvements.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the purchase of more than 1 firearm during any period of 30 days
sponsored.sum: Establishes the class A misdemeanor of unlawful procurement of a firearm, for the purchase or acquisition of more than 1 firearm during any period of 30 days.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of three-dimensional printed firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to the regulation of three-dimensional printed firearms; provides that a person who intentionally sells, distributes, or disposes of a three-dimensional printed firearm is guilty of a class A misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Includes broadband access in the scoring and ranking criteria of the New York State low-income housing tax credit program
sponsored.sum: Includes broadband access in the scoring and ranking criteria of the New York State low-income housing tax credit program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the delivery of telehealth services by veterinarians
sponsored.sum: Permits the delivery of telehealth services by veterinarians under certain conditions.

sponsored.t: Provides that upon sale of a limited-profit housing company project, reserve and surplus funds must be held in escrow and dedicated to major capital improvements
sponsored.sum: Provides that upon sale or other conveyance of a limited-profit housing company project to an entity other than a new limited-profit housing company, reserve and surplus funds must be held in escrow by the new owner and dedicated solely to defraying the costs of major capital improvements; provides that no rental may be increased to cover the cost of a major capital improvement until such reserve and surplus funds have been exhausted.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain presumptions for reckless driving and the implementation of a reckless driving and vehicular violence awareness component of the pre-licensing course for driver's licenses
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain presumptions for reckless driving and the implementation of a reckless driving and vehicular violence awareness component of the pre-licensing course for driver's licenses.

sponsored.t: Relates to wild or exotic animals
sponsored.sum: Provides that "wild animal" means indigenous, non-domesticated animals native to the country in which they live and "exotic animal" means a wild animal with an origin of a different continent; adds certain wild or exotic animals to the list of non-companion animals; provides certain owners of wild or exotic animals with a license process.

sponsored.t: Relates to the storage of evidence by law enforcement agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires law enforcement agencies to store physical or other evidence it maintains within fireproof containers or within a fireproof storage area; requires law enforcement agencies to document and photograph evidence before it is stored in a fireproof container or storage area; requires that such documents and photographs be stored in a different location.

sponsored.t: Relates to a housing authority's disposition of property
sponsored.sum: Relates to a housing authority's disposition of property.

sponsored.t: Relates to collection, storage or transmission of personal information collected from smart home systems
sponsored.sum: Requires express and affirmative consent prior to collection, storage or transmittal of any personal information obtained from the installation or use of a smart home connected system by certain persons.

sponsored.t: Adds animal fighting to the definition of criminal activity for purposes of enterprise corruption crimes
sponsored.sum: Includes animal fighting as a criminal act for purposes of enterprise corruption crimes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure and consideration of gender wage disparity in the awarding of state contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disclosure and consideration of gender wage disparity in the awarding of state contracts; requires all offerors to provide the percentage of gender wage disparity by job title for all state contracts; requires agencies to compile data received on gender wage disparity and provide data to the office of general services for publication on its website; requires agencies to provide extra credit or weight to offerors with a gender wage disparity of ten percent or less.

sponsored.t: Requires the notification of individuals that certain work-study, internship, externship or other work placements meet the work requirements of title nine-B of the social services law
sponsored.sum: Requires the notification of individuals that certain work-study, internship, externship or other work placements offered by institutions of higher education meet the work requirements of title nine-B of article five of the social services law.

sponsored.t: Provides that the sale of real property owned by the N.Y. city housing authority to a private entity must be approved by the state legislature
sponsored.sum: Provides that the sale of real property owned by the NYC housing authority to a private entity must be approved by the state legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance requirements for third-party food delivery services
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycle delivery contractors to provide personal injury liability insurance to compensate persons injured by a bicycle delivery worker and to provide notice to delivery workers that the contractor provides personal injury liability insurance; authorizes the superintendent of financial services to promulgate rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of primates in entertainment acts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of primates in entertainment acts; prohibits the department of environmental conservation for issuing any license or permit that would authorize the use of a primate in an entertainment act.

sponsored.t: Relates to limited-profit housing companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to limited-profit housing companies; authorizes certain companies to pay dividends or interest in excess of six percent per annum; relates to the dissolution of certain rental housing companies.

sponsored.t: Relates to releasing victims of domestic violence from certain contracts
sponsored.sum: Authorizes one or more individuals who are under a shared contract to opt-out of such contract without a fee, penalty or charge due to status as a domestic violence victim; prohibits the company from transferring any contractual or billing responsibility of such shared contract to any other account holders on such shared contract; prevents companies from prohibiting a person who has opted-out due to domestic violence status to enter into a new contract.

sponsored.t: Provides internet access and access to internet-enabled devices to recipients of public assistance and to adults and children in shelters and similar facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for internet access and access to internet-enabled devices to recipients of public assistance and to adults and children in shelters, domestic violence residence programs, and other adult and children residence facilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for personal property replacement as a result of bedbug infestation
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for personal property replacement as a result of bedbug infestation; credit of 15% not to exceed $750; certification determined by commissioner.

sponsored.t: Requires information to be posted concerning sidewalk sheds and scaffolds in NYC
sponsored.sum: Requires information to be posted concerning sidewalk sheds and scaffolds in NYC; relates to permit information.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL request made by state and local agencies or the state legislature
sponsored.sum: Prohibits agencies from charging for the process of a FOIL request made by state and local agencies or the state legislature.

sponsored.t: Relates to notice regarding the rent increase exemption for low income elderly persons and persons with disabilities programs
sponsored.sum: Requires certain agencies and individuals to provide notice regarding the rent increase exemption for low income elderly persons and persons with disabilities programs to tenants upon the occurrence of certain events.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for a building owner to refuse to renew a lease under the real estate industry stabilization code
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for a building owner to refuse to renew a lease under the real estate industry stabilization code; requires the owner of a building to be demolished to prove that such owner has the financial ability to complete demolition of the building.

sponsored.t: Provides for the authority of the department of health to engage in or support research on the health effects of artificial night light
sponsored.sum: Provides for authority of the department of health to engage in or support research on the health effects of artificial night light.

sponsored.t: Requires the New York city housing authority to provide adequate and reliable internet service for all housing authority residents
sponsored.sum: Requires the New York city housing authority to provide adequate and reliable internet service for all housing authority residents.

sponsored.t: Relates to monetary penalties that a parking violations bureau may impose for illegally idling the engine of a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to monetary penalties that a parking violations bureau may impose for illegally idling the engine of a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Exempts IRAs and Roth IRAs in the calculation of household benefits under public assistance programs
sponsored.sum: Exempts IRAs and Roth IRAs in the calculation of household benefits under public assistance programs.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable New York state taxpayers to electronically file income tax returns free of charge
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of taxation and finance to create and implement an online program which will enable each New York state taxpayer to prepare and electronically file such taxpayer's federal and state income tax returns free of charge.

sponsored.t: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws; repealer
sponsored.sum: Promotes understanding, awareness and enforcement of animal crimes laws.

sponsored.t: Requires landlord to grant access to engineer or architect hired by tenants to inspect major capital improvements in certain multiple dwellings
sponsored.sum: Provides that no landlord shall deny access to a licensed professional engineer or licensed registered architect hired by any tenant or tenant association representing tenants of a multiple dwelling of six units or more for the purpose of conducting an inspection of a major capital improvement for which an application for a maximum rent adjustment has been filed by the landlord; provides that such inspection shall be conducted after notice to the landlord and during normal business hours; provides for the filing of such inspection report by such tenants with the New York city rent agency or the state division of housing and community renewal for consideration in such application's…

sponsored.t: Prohibits the operation of horse drawn cabs in the city of New York; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of horse drawn cabs in the city of New York; defines the circumstances under which sale or disposal of a horse shall be deemed humane.

sponsored.t: Establishes the residential open green space tax abatement for certain properties in N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Establishes the residential open green space tax abatement for certain properties in a city of one million or more; provides an abatement for owners who remove an impermeable surface from a residential yard and replace it with soil and vegetation.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a training program for first responders for responding to victims of suspected drug overdose and the administration of opioid antagonists
sponsored.sum: Establishes a training program for first responders for responding to victims of suspected drug overdose and the administration of opioid antagonists.

sponsored.t: Prohibits using toxic ammunition in the taking of wildlife
sponsored.sum: Prohibits using toxic ammunition in the taking of wildlife; allows any federally approved nontoxic ammunition in the taking of wildlife.

sponsored.t: Relates to redetermination based on income for a tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to redetermination based on increases in income for a tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of the wellness program privacy act
sponsored.sum: Establishes the wellness program privacy act; requires employers and insurers to take certain measures to protect the security of wellness program participants' private information.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of financial services to study health insurance coverage through the Marketplace
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of financial services to study health insurance coverage through the Marketplace, including collecting data on how many people are insured, and studying the feasibility of creating programs, subsidies, and/or tax credits to help expand health care coverage.

sponsored.t: Relates to the training requirements for prescribers of certain pain medications
sponsored.sum: Relates to the training requirements for prescribers of certain pain medications.

sponsored.t: Prohibits entry to gun shows to anyone under twelve years of age
sponsored.sum: Prohibits entry to gun shows to anyone under twelve years of age.

sponsored.t: Relates to patient counseling before issuing a prescription for a schedule II opioid
sponsored.sum: Relates to patient counseling before issuing a prescription for a schedule II opioid; requires practitioners to consult with the patient regarding the quantity of the opioid and the patient's option to fill the prescription in a lesser quantity, and to inform the patient of the risks associated with opiate addiction and document the reason for the prescription.

sponsored.t: Limits animal dealers exempt under the provision of article 7 of such law relating to the licensing, identification and control of dogs
sponsored.sum: Limits the animal dealers that are exempt under the provisions of article 7 of the agriculture and markets law relating to the licensing, identification and control of dogs; applies provisions to dealers licensed as a class A dealer under the Federal Animal Welfare Act that sells dogs exclusively to USDA registered research facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to protections and rights afforded to delivery network company workers
sponsored.sum: Relates to protections and rights afforded to delivery network company (DNC) workers; requires DNCs to create internal procedures for workers to challenge deactivations; provides certain notice and other rights to workers to challenge deactivation both internally in a DNC and externally; allows the Department of Labor to investigate unwarranted deactivation of workers; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing copies of medical records to patients
sponsored.sum: Allows for patients to make a written request to receive copies of their medical records.

sponsored.t: Authorizes veterinarians to provide free veterinary care services to individuals in shelters to receive mandatory continuing education credit
sponsored.sum: Authorizes veterinarians to provide free veterinary care services to individuals in shelters as self-instructional coursework to receive credit for their continuing education requirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of income for tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of income for tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to health care proxy information on driver's licenses; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to health care proxy information on driver's licenses.

sponsored.t: Requires employers and employment agencies to notify candidates for employment if machine learning technology is used to make hiring decisions
sponsored.sum: Requires employers and employment agencies to notify candidates for employment if machine learning technology is used to make hiring decisions prior to the use of such technology.

sponsored.t: Restricts the locations of gunsmiths and dealers in firearms in relation to day cares, educational facilities, and places of worship
sponsored.sum: Restricts the locations of gunsmiths and dealers in firearms in relation to child day care or educational facilities, and places of worship.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the manufacture, distribution, sale and use of nail polish and nail hardener containing certain dibutyl phthalates (DBP), toluene, formaldehyde, formaldehyde resin, camphor, ethyl tosylamide, or xylene
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the manufacture, distribution, sale and use of nail polish or nail hardener containing certain dibutyl phthalates (DBP), toluene, formaldehyde, formaldehyde resin, camphor, ethyl tosylamide, and xylene; prohibits the use of such nail polish and nail hardener by appearance enhancement businesses.

sponsored.t: Requires a parent, law guardian or person legally responsible for a minor to be present during questioning by a peace or police officer
sponsored.sum: Requires a parent or other person legally responsible for a minor and the law guardian appointed pursuant to law to be present during questioning by a peace or police officer.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the offense of false pretense
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the offense of false pretense.

sponsored.t: Relates to reregulating units that were illegally deregulated from rent control or rent stabilization
sponsored.sum: Reregulates units that were illegally deregulated from rent control or rent stabilization.

sponsored.t: Relates to directing the department of health to study the potential health risks and effects of glyphosate and its by-product aminomethylphosphonic acid
sponsored.sum: Relates to directing the department of health to study the potential health risks and effects of glyphosate and its by-product aminomethylphosphonic acid; requires the commissioner of health to prepare a report for the governor and the legislature that includes the findings of such study, and to conduct an outreach program to inform local governments, private organizations, schools and the public regarding the findings of such report.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting lessees the option to pay security deposits in installments
sponsored.sum: Relates to permitting lessees the option to pay security deposits in six or fewer equal installments.

sponsored.t: Includes wildlife animals as those subject to the animal cruelty provisions
sponsored.sum: Includes wildlife animals as those subject to the animal cruelty provisions of the agriculture and markets law.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulation of toxic chemicals in pet products
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulation of toxic chemicals in pet products; requires disclosure on information on priority chemicals; establishes the interstate chemical clearinghouse; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires climate change and sustainability education in elementary and high schools
sponsored.sum: Requires that climate change and sustainability education be taught in elementary and high schools to educate pupils about how human activities cause climate change, the effects of climate change, the dangers associated with climate change and preventative measures that can be taken to alleviate the impacts of climate change.

sponsored.t: Exempts the sale of fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, heat sensors and carbon monoxide detectors from sales and use taxes
sponsored.sum: Exempts the sale of fire extinguishers, smoke alarms, heat sensors and carbon monoxide detectors for residential use only from state sales and compensating use taxes.

sponsored.t: Provides for the humane removal of downed animals
sponsored.sum: Provides for the humane treatment and removal of downed animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to analysis of data in the prescription monitoring program registry
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health analysis of data in the prescription monitoring program registry.

sponsored.t: Creates the women and high-wage, high-demand, nontraditional jobs grant program; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Creates the women and high-wage, high-demand, nontraditional jobs grant program; encourages and assists women to enter high-wage, high-demand occupations including but not limited to trades, science, technology, engineering, and math; makes an appropriation therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the requirement that injury be serious with respect to aggravated cruelty to animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to a cap on security deposits for residential leases of one year or longer
sponsored.sum: Relates to a cap on security deposits for residential leases of at least one year to the equivalent of one-month's rent under the lease.

sponsored.t: Expands the exemption provided to professional journalists and newscasters from contempt to include employment or association with a web log
sponsored.sum: Expands the exemption provided to professional journalists and newscasters from contempt to include employment or association with a web log; defines web log as a website or webpage that contains an online journal containing news, comments and offers hyperlinks provided by the writer.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring licensed slaughterhouses to have a closed circuit camera and television system in all areas with live animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring licensed slaughterhouses to have a closed circuit camera and television system in all areas with live animals; establishes a reporting requirement pursuant to inspections where a violation is found.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the storage of flavored vapor products near where vapor or tobacco products are sold at retail or wholesale
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the keeping of inventory, storage, warehouse, processing, packaging, shipping or distributing of flavored vapor products near where vapor or tobacco products are sold at retail or wholesale.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of certain medical solution containers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of certain medical solution containers containing PVC, DEHP or unintentionally added DEHP.

sponsored.t: Requires duly incorporated humane societies, a duly incorporated society for the prevention of cruelty to animals, pet dealers, or any pound microchip stray animals
sponsored.sum: Requires duly incorporated humane societies, a duly incorporated society for the prevention of cruelty to animals, pet dealers, or any pound microchip stray animals before making them available for adoption.

sponsored.t: Establishes the problem gambling advisory council
sponsored.sum: Establishes the problem gambling advisory council.

sponsored.t: Provides for the use of glucagon emergency injection kits by persons other than licensed health care professionals
sponsored.sum: Provides for the use of glucagon emergency injection kits by persons other than licensed health care professionals; provides for expanded use of epinephrine auto-injector devices in schools in emergency circumstances.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of sexual offense convictions and judgments against physicians
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of both criminal sexual offense convictions and civil liability judgments against physicians to patients when such sexual offenses were committed against patients.

sponsored.t: Relates to out-of-state investigations and warrants for legally protected health activity in New York state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits issuance of certain search warrants relating to out-of-state investigations of abortion services provided in NYS; prohibits corporations domiciled in NYS from complying with certain out-of-state search warrants regarding abortion services provided in NYS.

sponsored.t: Requires medical assistance to be provided to victims of domestic violence to care for and treat any scarring resulting from the domestic violence incident
sponsored.sum: Requires medical assistance be provided to victims of domestic violence to care for and treat any scarring resulting from the domestic violence incident.

sponsored.t: Requires child restraint systems to be equipped with sensors
sponsored.sum: Requires retailers to equip child restraint systems with sensors to notify drivers if a child has been left in the car.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York state green new deal for public housing act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York state green new deal for public housing act", which commissions a study to assist the state of New York in reaching its climate goals.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the purchase of single-use plastic bottles by the state and any governmental entity or political subdivision or public benefit corporation thereof
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the purchase of single-use plastic bottles by the state and any governmental entity or political subdivision or public benefit corporation thereof except for when required by health requirements, emergencies, or when no other alternative is available or practicable.

sponsored.t: Relates to the department of buildings keeping records regarding fatal construction accidents
sponsored.sum: Relates to the department of buildings keeping records regarding fatal construction accidents and posting all fatal accidents in the incident list.

sponsored.t: Relates to pension income and tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to pension income and tax abatement for rent-controlled and rent regulated property occupied by senior citizens or persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Enacts regulations of perchloroethylene dry cleaning facilities, including phase-out from residential buildings
sponsored.sum: Enacts regulations of perchloroethylene dry cleaning facilities; establishes equipment standards and specifications and operating requirements; provides for lead inspection and self monitoring and for management of perc-contaminated wastewater; makes numerous other regulatory provisions; includes phase-out from residential buildings.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability and use of opioid antagonists on trains
sponsored.sum: Requires the availability and permits the use of opioid antagonists on trains.

sponsored.t: Prohibits chain restaurants from charging extra for non-dairy alternatives in beverages
sponsored.sum: Prohibits chain restaurants from charging extra for non-dairy alternatives in beverages.

sponsored.t: Relates to the electrification of the Manhattan Cruise Terminal
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York City Economic Development Corporation to immediately commence any proceedings, processes, stakeholder engagement, or capital projects necessary for the installation of shore power capability at the Manhattan Cruise Terminal; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to adding certain notice requirements for enforcing liens on goods in self-storage facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding certain notice requirements for enforcing liens on goods in self-storage facilities.

sponsored.t: Prohibits any licensee who maintains, conducts or operates a parking lot or garage from increasing its schedule of rates by greater than ten percent over a twelve month period
sponsored.sum: Prohibits any licensee who maintains, conducts or operates a parking lot or garage from increasing its schedule of rates by greater than ten percent over a twelve month period.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring mental health practitioners to receive training on substance use disorder, the specific needs of the substance use disorder community and co-occurring disorders
sponsored.sum: Requires mental health practitioners to receive training on substance use disorder, the specific needs of the substance use disorder community and co-occurring disorders.

sponsored.t: Requires digital billboards to display each image for at least 60 consecutive seconds
sponsored.sum: Requires digital billboards to display each image for at least 60 consecutive seconds.

sponsored.t: Requires that plaintiffs no longer have to prove that a sexual offense occurred on the premises of, chattels or property belonging to a corporate entity
sponsored.sum: Requires that plaintiffs no longer have to prove that a sexual offense occurred on the premises of, chattels or property belonging to a corporate entity in action for negligent supervision.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the operation of establishments where animals and/or fowls are slaughtered or butchered for food
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the operation of establishments where animals and/or fowls are slaughtered or butchered for food; establishes a task force on public health risks and animal welfare concerns of slaughterhouses.

sponsored.t: Relates to recovery of certain housing accommodations by a landlord
sponsored.sum: Relates to recovery of certain housing accommodations by a landlord.

sponsored.t: Enacts hazing offenses and anti-hazing educational programs at educational institutions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts hazing offenses and anti-hazing educational programs at educational institutions and requires educational institutions to maintain a public report on hazing violations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the purchase and use of glyphosate by certain entities
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the purchase of glyphosate by any state department, agency, public benefit corporation or any pesticide applicator employed thereby as a contractor or subcontractor and the application of glyphosate on property owned, operated or leased by the state.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain owners of single family residential rental properties from being eligible for credits for interest payments and depreciation for such rental properties
sponsored.sum: Excludes certain owners of single family residential rental properties who own more than one single family residential rental property from being eligible for credits for interest payments and depreciation for such rental properties; provides exceptions for qualified nonprofit organization; defines terms; grants the commissioner of taxation and finance the authority to make rules and regulations pertaining to carrying out such provisions and preventing avoidance of compliance with such provisions.

sponsored.t: Includes coverage for menstrual products under the supplemental nutrition assistance program
sponsored.sum: Provides an additional monthly public assistance allowance of $15 for menstrual products, including but not limited to, tampons, sanitary napkins, cups and panty liners.

sponsored.t: Relates to review of certain contracts of a limited-profit housing company
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of housing and community renewal, or the appropriate supervising agency, to review contracts for $50,000 or more entered into by a limited-profit housing company.

sponsored.t: Provides for priority status to victims of human trafficking for the receipt of certain assistance
sponsored.sum: Provides for priority for applications and expedited determination of claims for a human trafficking victim who wishes to remove permanent marks that were part of the trafficking of such victim, including but not limited to, tattoos, markings, brandings, or other symbols or insignia.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of acupuncture and certain exemptions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the practice of acupuncture and the exemption that a person who does not otherwise possess the credentials or qualifications required for the practice of acupuncture may engage in the practice of auriculotherapy or "ear acupuncture" subject to certain restrictions.

sponsored.t: Relates to temporary certificates of compliance or occupancy
sponsored.sum: Relates to temporary certificates of compliance or occupancy; permits a single ninety day extension for temporary certificates of compliance or occupancy; requires a civil penalty of $20,000 for any violation regarding certificates of compliance or occupancy.

sponsored.t: Relates to methods used to capture or dispose of nuisance wildlife
sponsored.sum: Establishes that if lethal methods are used to capture or dispose of nuisance wildlife, the lethal method used and the reason why a non-lethal method was not used shall be submitted in an annual report; requires that a list of enforcement actions taken against any nuisance wildlife control operator for violations of the law and applicable regulations be annually updated.

sponsored.t: Relates to local government authority to prohibit trade in real fur products
sponsored.sum: Relates to local government authority to prohibit trade in real fur products, including but not limited to any article of clothing, fashion accessory, or home decoration that is made in whole or part of real fur.

sponsored.t: Restricts the use of total release fogging pesticides
sponsored.sum: Restricts the use of total release fogging pesticides unless the purchaser is licensed as a certified commercial pesticide applicator, certified residential pesticide applicator, or certified commercial pesticide technician in the state of New York or the purchaser is licensed in an equivalent manner in a jurisdiction with reciprocity with the state of New York, as determined by the department; restricts the use of total release fogging pesticides in multi-unit dwellings.

sponsored.t: Relates to animal insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits animal insurance policies from limiting or excluding pre-existing conditions.

sponsored.t: Requires the provision of assistive listening systems in New York state public transportation terminals
sponsored.sum: Requires the provision of assistive listening systems in New York state public transportation terminals.

sponsored.t: Requires certain affordable housing units to be subject to rent stabilization
sponsored.sum: Requires affordable housing units that are subject to the provisions of the Affordable New York Housing Program to be subject to rent stabilization at the end of the tax abatement and extended affordability period; provides that units subject to tax exemptions or abatements pursuant to other laws be subject to rent stabilization at the expiration of such tax exemptions or abatements.

sponsored.t: Relates to notification of the national bone marrow program; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to notification of the national bone marrow program on non-driver ids and license applications and voter applications.

sponsored.t: Requires reporting of positive cytomegalovirus results
sponsored.sum: Requires a local health department to report positive cytomegalovirus results.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure in human rights claims of government funding by the respondent
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure in human rights claims of government funding by the respondent; requires disclosure to government agencies of settlements notwithstanding nondisclosure agreements.

sponsored.t: Relates to recycling electronic cigarettes
sponsored.sum: Relates to recycling electronic cigarettes; requires electronic cigarette manufacturers to submit plans regarding the collection, transportation and recycling of electronic cigarettes to the commissioner of environmental conservation.

sponsored.t: Prevents nonresident race horse owners from avoiding use tax in certain situations; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions relating to use tax exemptions for certain race horses; prevents nonresident race horse owners from avoiding use tax in certain situations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disposition of abused farm animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disposition of abused farm animals; provides that convicted individuals and those in their households or those who aided or abetted in the unlawful acts or should have known or knew of such acts may not be entitled to any monies generated from the sale of the farm animals which were the basis of such conviction.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction on vaccine science in every middle school and every high school
sponsored.sum: Requires every middle school and every high school to provide instruction on vaccine science, including vaccine history and development, effects on the immune system, vaccine-preventable diseases and their spread, and vaccine safety and testing.

sponsored.t: Relates to the investment of funds wagered on video lottery gaming for certain horse races; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the investment of funds wagered on video lottery gaming for certain horse races.

sponsored.t: Relates to the right of tenant association to have the first option to purchase a housing unit
sponsored.sum: Relates to the right of tenant association to have the first option to purchase a housing unit.

sponsored.t: Relates to compensation for injury or death of a companion animal
sponsored.sum: Provides for compensation of an owner for the unjustifiable injury or death of a companion animal.

sponsored.t: Requires health practitioners to discuss with patients the risks associated with certain pain medications before prescribing such medications
