sponsored.sum: Requires health practitioners to discuss with patients the risks associated with certain pain medications before prescribing such medications; requires that for the first opioid analgesic prescription of a calendar year the prescribing physician shall counsel the patient on the risks of overdose.

sponsored.t: Provides additional protections at reproductive health clinics
sponsored.sum: Provides additional protections at reproductive health clinics; prohibits interference with phone lines, the release of offensive odors, and noises intended to jeopardize the health of persons receiving reproductive health services or to interfere with the safe and effective delivery of such services.

sponsored.t: Provides reimbursement for transportation to and from inpatient and outpatient diagnosis and treatment of substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Provides reimbursement for transportation to and from inpatient and outpatient diagnosis and treatment of substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants with fees for the payment of rent through an automated clearing house or online payment system
sponsored.sum: Prohibits residential landlords from charging tenants with fees for the payment of rent through an automated clearing house or online payment system.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding the animal population control fund
sponsored.sum: Allocates funding for the New York city animal population control fund for the animal population control program; monies that emanate from any resident or source in NYC from certain violations and fees shall be allocated to the NYC animal population control fund.

sponsored.t: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the commissioner of taxation and finance of certain violations of the labor law
sponsored.sum: Provides that the commissioner of labor shall notify the commissioner of taxation and finance of certain violations of the labor law relating to wages and hours of labor; provides that the commissioner of taxation and finance shall suspend certain certificates of authority of such employers in violation of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of automated decision tools by landlords for making housing decisions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of automated decision tools by landlords for making housing decisions; sets conditions and rules for use of such tools.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring schools to conduct annual lead testing
sponsored.sum: Requires schools to conduct annual lead testing on pipes and paint in all schools in New York city that provide schooling for children ages six and under and to remediate any presence of lead immediately if detected.

sponsored.t: Enables prosecutors to access orders of protection issued in association with sealed prior domestic violence cases
sponsored.sum: Enables prosecutors to access orders of protection issued in association with sealed prior domestic violence cases if the offender commits a new domestic violence offense.

sponsored.t: Exempts poll workers from the obligation to pay New York state income tax on income earned on an election day
sponsored.sum: Exempts poll workers from the obligation to pay New York state income tax on income earned on an election day.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Medicaid coverage to disabled persons attending an out-of-state college or university who are in need of continuous medical care
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Medicaid coverage to a disabled person attending an out-of-state college or university who is in need of continuous medical care and is a domiciliary of the state of New York; authorizes continuous coverage for services and care such person received while in-state; requires persons eligible for the provisions of this section must show proof of enrollment every semester.

sponsored.t: Creates special proceedings for freedom of information law and open meetings law reviews
sponsored.sum: Creates special proceedings for freedom of information law and open meetings law reviews; directs the chief administrator of the courts to establish a freedom of information law and open meetings law review program in the supreme court, whereby individuals may file a petition for review of a freedom of information law request or open meetings law claim.

sponsored.t: Requires 10% of the penalties imposed by the superintendent of financial services to be deposited in the community development financial institution fund
sponsored.sum: Requires 10% of the penalties imposed by the superintendent of financial services to be deposited in the community development financial institution fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to a pedestrian's right of way
sponsored.sum: Expands and clarifies when pedestrians shall be entitled to the right of way with respect to all other traffic.

sponsored.t: Permits tenants heat repair expense to be set off against rent
sponsored.sum: Allows tenants the right to offset rent with payments made for the repair or service maintenance of an oil fired or other heating device where reasonable efforts were made to notify the landlord of the heating failure, the agency used is reasonably engaged in the business of making such repairs and an itemized bill for such service is provided.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the importing, possession, or sale of any part or product of the skin or body of a kangaroo for commercial purposes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the importing, possession, or sale of any part or product of the skin or body of a kangaroo for commercial purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to distinctive license plates for society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to distinctive license plates for society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the aerial and ground application of malathion and certain pyrethroid-based insecticides
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the aerial and ground application of malathion and certain pyrethroid-based insecticides within one hundred feet of any school, day care center, park, or on other property when children are commuting to and from school or are engaged in outdoor activity.

sponsored.t: Requires the court to require a mental health evaluation when a person is convicted of certain crimes pertaining to animal fighting and aggravated cruelty to animals
sponsored.sum: Requires the court to require a mental health evaluation when a person is convicted of certain crimes pertaining to animal fighting and aggravated cruelty to animals; requires the convicted person to assume the costs of any evaluation and continued therapy; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Mandates commercial insurance coverage of peer support services as part of treatment for substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Mandates commercial insurance coverage of peer support services as part of treatment for substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Relates to issuing a certificate of compliance to any employer who achieves a gender pay gap of 10% or less
sponsored.sum: Relates to issuing a certificate of compliance to any employer who achieves a gender pay gap of 10% or less.

sponsored.t: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers
sponsored.sum: Provides access to live scan fingerprinting to society for the prevention of cruelty to animals officers.

sponsored.t: Requires the instruction of state and local government in elementary and middle schools in the state
sponsored.sum: Requires the regents to prescribe courses of instruction in state and local government in elementary and middle schools in the state; provides boards of education and trustees of the several cities and school districts of the state shall require instruction to be given in such courses by the teachers; requires similar instruction in private schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring hotels and motels to notify employees of the presence of bedbugs on the premises and requires development of training on eradication of bedbugs
sponsored.sum: Requires hotels and motels to notify employees of the presence of bedbugs on the premises; requires the development and administration of training on methods and procedures for the eradication of bedbugs upon hiring and each year thereafter.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring telephone corporations, cable television companies, and internet service providers to automatically refund their customers when their service is not working
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring telephone corporations, cable television companies, and internet service providers to automatically refund its customers when their service is not working; provides such credit shall be given even when the service is not working for less than a twenty-four hour period.

sponsored.t: Restricts individuals from owning a companion animal after being convicted of certain crimes involving animals
sponsored.sum: Restricts individuals from owning a companion animal after being convicted of certain crimes involving animals.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disclosure of information on the fiscal health of a condominium, cooperative apartment building or cooperative community
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disclosure of information on the fiscal health of a condominium, cooperative apartment building or cooperative community to prospective buyers, current owners and the condominium board or the cooperative board.

sponsored.t: Creates the rescued animals spay and neuter fund
sponsored.sum: Creates the rescued animals spay and neuter fund; authorizes the department of taxation and finance to place a check-off box on income tax returns for taxpayers to contribute money to the fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to reckless driving; relates to culpability regarding criminal homicide involving the use of a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Relates to reckless driving; relates to culpability regarding criminal homicide involving the use of a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Requires school meal nutritional facts and ingredient list be provided for such meals
sponsored.sum: Requires school meal nutritional facts and ingredient list be provided for meals provided to students before serving such meal; allows such information to be posted on the school district website; requires the school district to notify parents or guardians of any changes in the meals, the new nutritional facts, and the itemized list of ingredients.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing student onboarding and ongoing education on reproductive health services
sponsored.sum: Requires student onboarding and ongoing education on reproductive health services available to students including where the closest reproductive health clinics are located; all resources available to a student seeking reproductive health services including but not limited to financial assistance and mental health services and any reproductive health resources available to a student through the institution.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a company climate report system to assess the workplace environment of companies doing business in New York
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a company climate report system to assess the workplace environment of companies doing business in New York with a focus on sexual harassment and discrimination policies and the frequency and handling of claims, settlements and cases by such companies.

sponsored.t: Requires the mobilization of the New York guard for certain power outages and requires power outage restoration training for members of the New York guard
sponsored.sum: Requires the mobilization of the New York guard for certain power outages; requires power outage restoration training for members of the New York guard.

sponsored.t: Requires licensed day care facilities to contact a child's parent or guardian if they are absent from day care without providing prior notice
sponsored.sum: Requires licensed day care facilities to contact a child's parent or guardian if they are absent from day care, with no prior notice given, within thirty minutes after such child is recorded as absent.

sponsored.t: Establishes a credit against income tax for service dogs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a credit against income tax for service dogs.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting discrimination against a person based upon weight
sponsored.sum: Relates to prohibiting discrimination against a person based upon weight; excepts where deviation may pose a threat to the individual, other patrons, or the general public.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of education to establish a commission to study the needs of adolescents and the effect that school day start times have on students
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to establish a commission to study the needs of adolescents and the effect that school day start times have on the health and academic performance of students.

sponsored.t: Relates to the installation of radiator covers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the installation of radiator covers.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax credit for rent paid on the personal residence of certain taxpayers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a tax credit for rent paid on the personal residence of certain taxpayers who lease the taxpayer's primary residence during the taxable year and who pay rent with respect to such residence in excess of thirty percent of such taxpayer's gross income for such taxable year.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of disposable electronic cigarettes
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of disposable electronic cigarettes.

sponsored.t: Relates to limited profit housing companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to limited profit housing companies.

sponsored.t: Changes the default standard on statutory health proxy forms regarding life-sustaining treatment standards
sponsored.sum: Relates to life-sustaining treatment standards.

sponsored.t: Provides for the licensure of lactation consultants and the establishment of a lactation consultant licensing board
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensure of lactation consultants and the establishment of a lactation consultant licensing board.

sponsored.t: Relates to acts of animal cruelty in the presence of a child
sponsored.sum: Defines "aggravated cruelty"; makes any person who commits the conduct which falls under that definition guilty of a class E felony, punishable by up to two years imprisonment; defines "in the presence of a child" and makes any person who commits the conduct which falls under that definition, guilty of a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Requires cytomegalovirus screening for every newborn
sponsored.sum: Requires cytomegalovirus screening for every newborn by administration of a dried blood spot or a urine polymerase chain reaction (PCR) test.

sponsored.t: Relates to rent impairing violations and eviction proceedings
sponsored.sum: Relates to rent impairing violations and eviction proceedings.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracting for certain construction projects by public housing authorities
sponsored.sum: Relates to alternative project delivery contracts for certain construction projects by housing authorities.

sponsored.t: Regulates the use of artificial intelligence in aiding decisions on rental housing and loans
sponsored.sum: Regulates the use of artificial intelligence in aiding decisions on rental housing and loans; requires a study on the impact of artificial intelligence and machine learning on housing discrimination and redlining.

sponsored.t: Relates to determination of public assistance eligibility
sponsored.sum: Relates to determination of public assistance eligibility; reduces time frame for determinations on safety net assistance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the enactment of the Safer Consumption Services Act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the safer consumption services act which provides for the establishment of a program to provide safe injection sites.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of an indoor area; and to repealing certain provisions of the public health law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of an indoor area.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the NY privacy act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the NY privacy act to require companies to disclose their methods of de-identifying personal information, to place special safeguards around data sharing and to allow consumers to obtain the names of all entities with whom their information is shared.

sponsored.t: Provides grounds for attachment and relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft
sponsored.sum: Provides grounds for attachment; relates to procedures where employees may hold shareholders of non-publicly traded corporations personally liable for wage theft; relates to rights for victims of wage theft to hold the ten members with the largest ownership interests in a company personally liable for wage theft; relates to penalties for certain wage violations.

sponsored.t: Exempts first-time homebuyers from the mortgage recording tax
sponsored.sum: Exempts first-time homebuyers from the mortgage recording tax.

sponsored.t: Relates to media literacy education
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "media literacy act"; requires teachers and library media specialists to complete professional development related to media literacy education; requires a school library media specialist in each elementary, intermediate, middle, junior high and senior high school; directs the commissioner of education to appoint a media literacy advisory committee to study the teaching of media literacy; creates a media literacy advisory committee to annually review policy and procedures on media literacy.

sponsored.t: Relates to orders of protection with respect to companion animals
sponsored.sum: Relates to orders of protection with respect to companion animals; provides further protection for pets by authorizing the court to order a party to either relinquish a pet or to refrain from any contact with a pet.

sponsored.t: Requires affordable housing units to be equally distributed throughout building projects
sponsored.sum: Requires affordable housing units to be equally distributed throughout building projects.

sponsored.t: Requires the disposal of copies of identification documents
sponsored.sum: Requires the disposal of copies of identification documents by owner, lessee, proprietor or manager of any hotel, motel, steamboat, tourist cabins, camp, resort, tavern, inn, boarding or lodging house.

sponsored.t: Relates to health care proxy information on driver's licenses
sponsored.sum: Provides space on a driver's license for health care proxy information.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring notification by mortgagees commencing foreclosure actions to aid in the identification and improvements of at-risk properties
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring written notification by mortgagees commencing foreclosure actions on a multiple dwelling with ten or more units to the department of housing preservation and development to aid in the identification and improvements of at-risk properties.

sponsored.t: Requires the replacement of certain rent stabilized housing accommodations
sponsored.sum: Requires rent stabilized housing accommodations lost or destroyed due to fire, natural disaster, act of God, act of war or eminent domain, to be replaced in any succeeding construction on the same parcel.

sponsored.t: Establishes a parent and education awareness program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a parent and education awareness program to raise parental awareness of the harmful effects of conflict on their children and expose parents to better ways to support their children during a family transition.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the department of environmental conservation from issuing or authorizing any permits to new or expanding large concentrated animal feeding operations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the department of environmental conservation from issuing or authorizing any permits to new or expanding large concentrated animal feeding operations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits private insurers from charging co-payments for an annual pediatric eye exam completed by an optometrist or ophthalmologist
sponsored.sum: Prohibits private insurers from charging co-payments for an annual pediatric eye exam completed by an optometrist or ophthalmologist.

sponsored.t: Requires comprehensive eye examinations for certain public school students
sponsored.sum: Requires comprehensive eye examinations for students entering public school for the first time and within sixty days where any student fails a school administered vision screening examination; requires regulations.

sponsored.t: Prohibits an individual with a vested interest or government agency from having a cause of action against a library staff member who refuses to remove such library materials
sponsored.sum: Prohibits an individual with a vested interest or government agency from having a cause of action against a library staff member who refuses to remove such library materials whether such library materials belongs to a school or public library.

sponsored.t: Enacts the community gridlock prevention act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the community gridlock prevention act, which requires all land use actions to include an intersection and response time of emergency services impact study in addition to any existing requirements for an environmental assessment statement or an environmental impact statement.

sponsored.t: Prohibits gifts or other incentives for the purchase of oral nicotine pouches
sponsored.sum: Prohibits gifts, rewards, or other incentives for the purchase of oral nicotine pouches.

sponsored.t: Provides retroactivity to the original date of eligibility in certain cases for the senior citizens rent increase exemption (SCRIE) and disability rent increase exemption (DRIE)
sponsored.sum: Provides retroactivity to the original date of eligibility for the senior citizens rent increase exemption (SCRIE) and disability rent increase exemption (DRIE).

sponsored.t: Creates the "Paid-In Act"; exempts used books from sales use taxes, up to one hundred dollars per item
sponsored.sum: Exempts used books from sales use taxes including second-hand purchases, up to one hundred dollars per item.

sponsored.t: Redefines the term "following" for a crime of stalking in the fourth degree
sponsored.sum: Redefines the term "following" for a crime of stalking in the fourth degree to include the use of certain devices or computers to gain access to, record, track or report the movement or location of a person or their property without the person's permission or authority to do so.

sponsored.t: Prohibits real property that has converted from Mitchell-Lama to a housing development fund company from retaining certain tax benefits
sponsored.sum: Prohibits real property that has converted from a limited-profit housing company to a housing development fund company from being eligible for a shelter rent tax abatement.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "safekeeping and access to video evidence (SAVE) act"
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities and other public officials to retain security recordings for a minimum of fifteen months.

sponsored.t: Relates to limits on overdraft fees charged by certain state chartered banking institutions
sponsored.sum: Provides that charges imposed by certain state chartered banking institutions in connection with a check or other written order drawn on insufficient funds shall not exceed the greater of five dollars or the pro rata share of such state chartered banking institution's total direct costs and charge-off losses for providing non-covered overdraft credit.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of certain birds at retail
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of birds at retail pet shops; provides exceptions for certain domesticated game birds and other birds including chickens, turkeys, guinea fowl, peafowl and pigeons.

sponsored.t: Requires the establishment of health and safety guidelines for cats living in retail food stores
sponsored.sum: Requires the establishment of health and safety guidelines for cats living in retail food stores to ensure the humane treatment of such cats while adhering to relevant health code provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to rent guidelines boards and the factors to be considered in establishing annual rent adjustments; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends the composition of rent guidelines boards and the factors to be considered in establishing annual rent adjustments; eliminates the price index of operating costs as a factor in determining rent increases.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting safety and privacy by stopping the sale of location data
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the collection or processing of an individual's location information except for a permissible purpose; requires an entity collecting location information for the provision of multiple permissible purpose to maintain a location privacy policy obtain consent from the individual the information pertains to; prohibits the disclosure or sale of such information except for certain purposes; provides remedies for violations.

sponsored.t: Requires new residential construction sellers to inform buyers of any price increase caused by tariffs on building materials
sponsored.sum: Requires sellers of new residential construction to inform buyers of any price increase caused by tariffs on building materials.

sponsored.t: Expands the veterans' preference to include veterans who did not serve during a time of war for certain housing
sponsored.sum: Expands the veterans' preference to include veterans who did not serve during a time of war for Mitchell-Lama housing.

sponsored.t: Relates to fingerprinting and background checks of contracted service providers of student support services
sponsored.sum: Relates to the fingerprinting and background checks of providers of contract services to covered schools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits discrimination based upon housing status
sponsored.sum: Prohibits discrimination based upon housing status.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting bail enforcement agents from using their position to enforce immigration actions
sponsored.sum: Provides that it shall be unlawful for a bail enforcement agent to use such bail enforcement agent's position to enforce any immigration action.

sponsored.t: Relates to use of virtual agents and AI tools in property searches
sponsored.sum: Requires real estate brokers and online housing platforms using virtual agents and AI tools to conduct a disparate impact analysis to assess the actual impact of any such virtual agent; requires such individuals to submit a summary of the most recent disparate impact analysis to the attorney general's office; requires online housing platforms using virtual agents to provide an option to communicate with a human representative; makes certain provisions requiring anti-discriminatory measures for virtual agents and AI tools.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalties for internet-based food-ordering service providers failing to provide a link to the city of New York health department or local health department
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalties for internet-based food-ordering service providers failing to provide a link to the city of New York health department or local health department and the amount of such penalty depending on whether such inter-based food-ordering service is primarily a restaurant or just app-based.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting the department of taxation and finance to share a person's address with the office of the state comptroller for the purpose of returning unclaimed funds
sponsored.sum: Provides that the department of taxation and finance shall be permitted to share with the office of the state comptroller a person's address, based on such person's most recently filed tax return, for the purpose of returning unclaimed funds to such person.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the investment of certain public funds with companies owned by elected officials
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain public funds from being invested in companies owned by elected officials.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force focused on preventive care in the event federal standards are changed or revoked
sponsored.sum: Establishes a task force focused on preventive care in the event federal standards are changed or revoked; establishes the terms, pay and makeup of such taskforce.

sponsored.t: Relates to nonhuman primates in testing and research facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to nonhuman primates in testing and research facilities; provides that an animal testing facility no longer in need of a nonhuman primate in its possession shall consider options for and determine the appropriate care of such nonhuman primate, including releasing such nonhuman primate to a certified sanctuary; provides that a higher education research facility that receives public money, or a facility that provides research in collaboration with a higher education facility, shall annually publish certain information on its website concerning nonhuman primates at such facility.

sponsored.t: Requires course work or training in menopausal health for certain professions
sponsored.sum: Requires course work or training in menopausal health for physicians, physician assistants, nurses, mental health practitioners, psychologists and social workers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the introduction of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress; defines "sexual conduct"; requires the motion, related materials, and the record of the hearing be and remain sealed.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "refuting false knowledge act" relating to establishing a medical misinformation task force
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "refuting false knowledge act" relating to establishing a medical misinformation task force within the department of health to combat medical misinformation provided by the federal government.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 79th Street subway station to the 79th Street-Saul Zabar station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 79th Street subway station to the 79th Street - Saul Zabar station; provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "protection, respect, inclusion, dignity, and equality (PRIDE) care act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes a home care services bill of rights for patients of home care services agencies and certified home health agencies; requires training for staff and contractors of such agencies to eliminate certain discriminations; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires utility companies or municipalities act with due diligence in providing notice to tenants of multiple dwellings about gas, electric or steam services being shut off
sponsored.sum: Requires utility companies or municipalities act with due diligence in providing notice to tenants of multiple dwellings about gas, electric or steam services being shut off; provides a cause of action for tenants who were not provided proper notice; provides protections for landlords of multiple dwellings with regard to deferred payment agreements; requires a utility or municipality provide employees who serve as a point of contact for each multiple dwelling they provide services for.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "safeguarding reproductive care act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "safeguarding reproductive care act" under which a stockpile of mifepristone and misoprostol is maintained and managed to ensure continued access to reproductive care medications within the state.

sponsored.t: Regulates companion chatbots
sponsored.sum: Regulates companion chatbots by requiring such companion chatbots include a warning.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting in-play sports wagers
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Directs the state gaming commission to prohibit in-play sports wagers from bettors in this state.

sponsored.t: Prohibits Medicaid from requiring prior authorization for certain HIV medications
sponsored.sum: Prohibits Medicaid service providers from requiring prior authorization for antiretroviral prescription drugs for the treatment or prevention of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS).

sponsored.t: Prohibits contracts for the purchase or financing of a dog or cat from online websites from including provisions allowing repossession of the animal
sponsored.sum: Prohibits contracts for the purchase or financing of a dog or cat from online websites from including provisions allowing repossession of the animal.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to create an informational pamphlet concerning intrauterine devices; requires such informational pamphlet to be available on the department of health's website; requires practitioners to distribute such informational pamphlet to patients seeking contraceptives.

sponsored.t: Defines closed period of eligibility for purposes of certain supplemental security income and includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income
sponsored.sum: Defines "closed period of eligibility" for purposes of supplemental security income for aged, blind, and disabled persons; includes such time period in the eligibility requirements of such supplemental security income.

I support SSP as critical additional support for elderly, blind, and disabled New Yorkers.…

sponsored.t: Includes consideration of evidence of recent acts of aggravated cruelty to animals as a factor to be considered when determining whether grounds for a temporary extreme risk protection order exist
sponsored.sum: Includes consideration of evidence of recent acts of aggravated cruelty to animals as a factor to be considered when determining whether grounds for a temporary extreme risk protection order exist.

sponsored.t: Relates to the powers of the New York state housing finance agency
sponsored.sum: Extends certain powers of the New York state housing finance agency.

sponsored.t: Establishes transparency guidelines for condominiums and cooperative housing units
sponsored.sum: Requires that when a buyer enters into a contract to purchase a condominium or cooperative housing unit, the property management company or board of managers shall provide the buyer with records of the most recent inspection and engineering reports and permits for the subject property.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer
sponsored.sum: Requires advertisements to disclose the use of a synthetic performer; imposes a $1,000 civil penalty for a first violation and a $5,000 penalty for any subsequent violation.

sponsored.t: Extends certain provisions relating to the COVID-19 emergency rental assistance program
sponsored.sum: Extends certain provisions relating to payments under the COVID-19 emergency rental assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of algorithmic pricing by landlords for the purpose of determining the amount of rent to charge a residential tenant
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a person or entity from knowingly or with reckless disregard facilitate an agreement between or among two or more residential rental property owners or managers to not compete with respect to residential rental dwelling units, including by operating or licensing a software, data analytics service, or algorithmic device that performs a coordinating function on behalf of or between and among such residential rental property owners or managers.

sponsored.t: Requires that pharmacies that are permanently discontinuing to notify customers of such discontinuance
sponsored.sum: Requires pharmacies that are permanently discontinuing to notify customers of such discontinuance and provide information including locations of other nearby pharmacies.

sponsored.t: Establishes a right of action for claims arising out of coerced debts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits creditors from enforcing a consumer debt incurred as a result of fraud, duress, intimidation, threat, force, identity theft, exploitation of the debtor's personal information or similar economic abuse perpetrated against a debtor; establishes a right of action by the debtor for relief against creditors for violations; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Expands the definition of epinephrine devices to include epinephrine nasal sprays
sponsored.sum: Defines epinephrine device as a single-use device or nasal spray device used for the automatic injection or administration of a premeasured dose of epinephrine into the human body for the purpose of emergency treatment of a person appearing to experience anaphylactic symptoms.

sponsored.t: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based solely on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds
sponsored.sum: Prohibits restrictions on insurance policies based solely on the policyholder harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds.

sponsored.t: Relates to amending provisions requiring the termination of connected vehicle services upon the request of a domestic violence victim
sponsored.sum: Amends certain provisions requiring the termination of connected vehicle services upon the request of a domestic violence victim; requires the provider of the connected vehicle services to terminate such services within two days of receiving a request; directs the office for the prevention of domestic violence to make information available on their website; defines terms.

sponsored.t: Requires certain health insurance policies to cover scalp cooling systems for the preservation of hair during cancer chemotherapy treatment; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires certain large group health insurance policies and contracts to cover scalp cooling systems for the preservation of hair during cancer chemotherapy treatment.

sponsored.t: Makes technical changes to certain provisions requiring epinephrine auto-injector devises to be made available in places of public assembly
sponsored.sum: Makes technical changes to certain provisions requiring epinephrine auto-injector devices to be made available in places of public assembly; amends the effectiveness of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides for the restriction of substances in menstrual products
sponsored.sum: Restricts certain substances from being used in menstrual products.

sponsored.t: Increases the New York state housing finance agency bonding authority
sponsored.sum: Increases the New York state housing finance agency bonding authority to $36,280,000,000.

sponsored.t: Provides for the protection of health information
sponsored.sum: Provides for the protection of health information; establishes requirements for communications to individuals about their health information; requires either written consent or a designated necessary purpose for the processing of an individual's health information.
